cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_001: Hi. Here for that security reassessment I promised. You do open the door for guests with appointments, right?
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_002: Booking a break-in is not an appointment. It's advance notice of a crime.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_003: You say that, but you kept my note. Were you waiting for me?
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_004: I kept it as evidence. At the very back of the throne drawer.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_005: My lord, you did not need to disclose the hiding place.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_006: Today's score is irrelevant. Lose a single gold coin, and my skull will lose its shine.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_007: First time I've seen a skeleton worry about its complexion.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_008: My complexion is the balance in the vault.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_009: You stamped those supply crates, right? Another thief followed me here. Your publicity's working.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_010: I advertised, and got more thieves instead of customers.
cues.STORY_D06_MANAGEMENT_011: I'd abolish our marketing department, but we haven't even founded one.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_001: The explorers will open the main route while Nia and the thieves push toward the Treasury.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_002: Pudding, hold the line. Gob, chase down any thieves slipping away. Pynn, burn through the gaps from the rear.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_003: Gaps burn too? Then Gob hit them before they all burn up!
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_004: Don't race my fireballs. Last time, only your fringe lost.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_005: Fine today. Already short. Nobody notice.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_006: Is Nia going to keep coming to fight us?
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_007: For now, she's an enemy. But see even an enemy often enough, and you start calling them by name.
cues.STORY_D06_PRECOMBAT_008: Touching. Now call my name and toss me the vault key!
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_01_001: The explorers cleared the way. I'll head for the expensive stuff, as usual.
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_01_002: As usual? It's your second visit! Stop pretending you're a regular!
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_01_003: No loyalty discounts! Repeat intruders pay a surcharge!
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_01_004: Catch me and I'll settle up. Otherwise, I'll take what I reckon I'm owed.
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_02_001: Got you! No, nearly got you! No, getting you now!
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_02_002: Less running commentary. More actual running.
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_02_003: Your movements are better than before. You really are learning.
cues.STORY_D06_COMBAT_02_004: You keep coming to test us. Be ready to give us full marks next time.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_001: I'll grade your movements more than your doors. And what you actually managed to protect.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_002: At last, a thief recognizes my castle as an educational institution.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_003: We received a repair bill instead of tuition.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_004: Empty-handed this time. I'll have to raise your score quite a bit.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_005: Treasury balance confirmed. My complexion has returned.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_006: Your bones are the same color as before.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_007: Got a few coins. Your pursuit's faster, but the vault door is still very forthcoming.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_008: The balance has dropped. So has the color in my face.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_009: Your bones do look a little paler.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_010: Some complexions are visible only to accountants.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_011: Fix up your facilities. Next time, it won't be me. It'll be people who just smash their way in.
cues.STORY_D06_RESULT_WIN_012: Nia has a point. Tomorrow, we will discuss making one of our facilities sturdier.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_001: For 90 gold and 30 mana, we can upgrade one facility by one level.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_002: Why are those numbers so proudly enormous? At least pretend to be sorry.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_003: 90 gold... 30 mana... My apologies. The price remains unchanged.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_004: The Barracks offer stability, the Watch Post responds quickly to thieves, and the Recovery Nest helps in long battles.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_005: No option to make the throne softer?
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_007: No. The defense line comes before your lower back, my lord.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_008: Pudding's happy anywhere. Just not under a leaky ceiling. It keeps ruining the seasoning.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_009: Barracks bigger! Now Gob stop punching wall in sleep!
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_010: The fact that you punch things in your sleep is the bigger problem.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_011: We should be able to spot thieves' flanking routes sooner.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_012: Nice angle on that watch post window. I'll find a blind spot next time.
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_013: So soft! Pudding comes in here and gets all bouncy again, like a dessert!
cues.STORY_D07_MANAGEMENT_014: This looks more like a holiday resort than a medical facility.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_001: Choosing just one is harder than I thought. Can't we fix them all?
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_002: Certainly. If your future self sends your present self the money.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_003: Gob like big rooms! Swing fist without hitting wall!
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_004: That has more to do with your sense of direction than room size.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_005: A better Recovery Nest means Pudding gets bouncy again faster.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_006: There is no single right answer. Choose a facility that suits today's formation and your future plans.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_007: Right. We'll build the perfect castle later. Today, we build the castle we need.
cues.STORY_D07_PRECOMBAT_008: Your first truly lordly statement within budget. I'll make a note of it.
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_01_001: Explorers are entering along the main route. A thief will head for the Treasury later.
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_01_002: Hold around the upgraded facility! We paid for it, so make it earn its keep!
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_01_003: An admirable commitment to recovering our investment.
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_01_004: Do we have to take accounting lessons in battle too?
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_02_001: Upgraded room strong! Can Gob punch wall once?
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_02_002: Punch the enemy! Testing our facilities' durability is not on today's agenda!
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_02_003: Pudding will block the front. New room, help us from behind!
cues.STORY_D07_COMBAT_02_004: The defense line is stable. The chosen facility is doing its job.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_001: We fixed one wall, and the whole castle looks a little prouder.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_002: The wall isn't proud. It simply isn't collapsing. A major improvement.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_003: The investment was substantial, but projected repairs are down. A profit in the long run.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_004: Gob feel stronger too. Or just look stronger because room bigger?
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_005: No. Your punches sound heavier than before.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_006: Pudding feels bouncier too. Do we get upgraded like rooms?
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_007: So the facilities aren't the only things growing. You are too.
cues.STORY_D07_RESULT_WIN_008: Tomorrow, we will examine Pudding, Gob, and Pynn's progress. Rolo's scouting report should arrive as well.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_001: My lord, Pudding's body got tougher. Pudding bumped into a wall yesterday, and the wall said sorry first.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_003: No. It just cracked all over, so it looked sorry.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_004: The repair bill we just settled is walking right back in.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_005: Gob faster too! After breakfast, caught bowl before it hit floor!
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_006: You're the one who dropped it.
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_007: Made problem. Solved problem. Gob do work of two people!
cues.STORY_D08_MANAGEMENT_008: It may sound like a joke, but these are real signs of growth. All three are preparing for their next roles.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_001: My fireballs got bigger too. Tested one yesterday. Put out three candles at once.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_002: You fired fire, and the candles went out?
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_003: Bit of a blast wave. Those scorch marks on the ceiling were already there.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_004: Scouting report! Four explorers spotted, with one thief trailing behind.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_005: Will you join the defense today, Rolo?
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_006: For now, I'm more useful running with a map. If it catches fire in battle, we'll all get lost.
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_007: Why are you looking at me?
cues.STORY_D08_PRECOMBAT_008: Understood. Rolo, take the outside roads. We'll guard the castle.
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_01_001: Today, we test your growth. Don't let the lone thief near the end slip past.
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_01_002: Pudding will hold longer than yesterday!
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_01_004: Then I'll roast them hotter than yesterday.
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_02_001: We're testing your growth, not holding a castle-burning contest!
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_02_002: Thief entering from the rear! Currently tying a shoelace at the corridor corner!
cues.STORY_D08_COMBAT_02_004: Careless, not nice. Catch them now.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_001: Pudding really lasted longer! Someday, could Pudding block the whole entrance alone?
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_002: You don't have to do it alone. But if that's what you want, you'll become our strongest shield.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_003: Gob become Gob who catches every running enemy!
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_004: And I'll be the Pynn who finishes off everyone you two catch, all at once.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_005: I'll spread that story through the village. With three times the excitement.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_006: Three times would be false advertising.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_007: Let's settle on two and a half.
cues.STORY_D08_RESULT_WIN_008: Exaggeration may be unnecessary. The kingdom is sending Iris, an official investigator.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_001: Today's visitor is no mere explorer. The kingdom's investigator, Iris, is coming in person.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_002: An investigator? Is this about taxes?
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_003: In that case, I'll be the first to flee.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_004: Iris will record the routes from the entrance to the Barracks, Treasury, and even the throne.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_005: Can't we just steal the map?
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_006: With that sort of person, the records in their head are more accurate than the map.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_007: Then hit head, knock records out?
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_008: Your approach to problem-solving is as direct as ever.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_009: My analysis isn't finished, yet the defense line moved sooner than expected.
cues.STORY_D09_MANAGEMENT_010: Remember: the observer is also being observed.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_001: Entrance width, corridor length, guard rotations. This layout is more deliberate than expected.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_002: Naturally. Every stone was placed according to my brilliant design.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_003: Half was already a cave. The other half consists of construction errors.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_004: 'Demon Lord frequently confuses fact with theatrical effect.'
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_006: Investigator, I've visited that room three times. I come out somewhere different every time.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_007: The route hasn't changed. You've taken the wrong one each time.
cues.STORY_D09_PRECOMBAT_008: Oh. Then I'll have to rewrite all three reports.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_01_001: Pudding anchors the front, while Pynn adds firepower from the rear. Gob fills the gaps.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_01_002: Don't pass arbitrary judgment on my minions in the middle of battle.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_01_003: It isn't arbitrary. It's observation. The three work together better than expected.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_02_001: Don't get excited over enemy praise. Still, the record's accurate.
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_02_002: Write about Gob too! 'Super strong and even super stronger!'
cues.STORY_D09_COMBAT_02_004: Two thieves are moving behind the investigator. Don't lose the vault while worrying about the report.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_001: This castle hasn't survived by chance. I'll raise its threat rating in my report.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_002: At last, an official royal document recognizes my majesty.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_003: A higher threat rating is not a congratulatory card. It means more troops.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_004: Majesty always comes with a bill.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_005: I'll change my old report title from 'Suspicious Hole' to 'Highly Suspicious Castle.'
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_006: You finally called it a castle. Today's greatest achievement.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_007: By tomorrow, this place will be on the guild noticeboard. After that, expect hunting parties, not accidental visitors.
cues.STORY_D09_RESULT_WIN_008: And at the back of that party, we will likely find Leon, having studied the map again.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_001: Big news! Bad news! Or possibly good news! Our castle's name is on the guild noticeboard!
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_002: At last! Did they spell it correctly?
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_003: One letter was wrong, so I fixed it in secret. The handwriting looks a little different.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_004: The bounty is still small. The name takes up more space than the reward.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_005: Should I shorten the name or increase the bounty?
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_006: No time to ponder that. A team is coming to verify Iris's report.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_007: My report was accurate. Today, I'll make a final assessment of your actual defenses.
cues.STORY_D10_MANAGEMENT_008: And this time, I've read the map! I won't get lost right at the entrance again!
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_001: Leon, did you bring a new manual?
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_002: Of course. I even bookmarked 'How to Conquer a Small Demon Castle.'
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_004: I wanted to write 'Huge Demon Castle,' but that left far too much blank paper.
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_005: That hero's taunts are improving faster than his skills.
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_006: Leon's back! We just stop him getting through again, right?
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_007: Gob remember Leon! Person who takes lots of hitting to fall down!
cues.STORY_D10_PRECOMBAT_008: Three explorers, one investigator, one thief, and Leon at the end. Today calls for everything we've learned about deployment.
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_01_001: Front line holding, confirmed. Response at the Treasury is faster too.
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_01_002: Stop taking notes and retreat. Today's report already has a conclusion: 'Invasion failed!'
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_01_003: Don't think the same route and traps will catch me again! I've studied them all!
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_01_004: Then here's your test. First question: what's the fastest way to avoid a fireball?
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_02_001: Raise my shield and move left... or was it right?
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_02_002: The correct answer is not entering someone else's castle in the first place.
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_02_003: Mock me all you like! This time, I'm reaching the Demon Lord's throne!
cues.STORY_D10_COMBAT_02_004: Come, Leon. We've grown while you've studied. Let's find out who learned more!
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_001: Lost again. I memorized the map, but your movements weren't on it.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_002: A castle isn't just its rooms. It's the ones moving inside who make it a castle.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_005: I'll amend the guild report. This is a growing demon castle, not a temporary den.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_006: We've cleared our first major hurdle. The kingdom can no longer dismiss us as an accident.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_007: Instead, phrases like 'official warning,' 'investigation fees,' and 'registration review' are charging toward my ledger.
cues.STORY_D10_RESULT_WIN_008: I just saw a messenger! A warning bearing the royal seal arrives tomorrow morning!
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: Deep in the mountains stood a cave: a dot on the map that even delivery drivers couldn't find.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: Ahem. From this day forth, this is my demon lord's castle. Soon the kingdom shall tremble!
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: The drops on the ceiling appear to be trembling first.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: That's atmosphere. The entire cave is so terrified it's breaking into a cold sweat.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: Maintaining that atmosphere requires two buckets. Our budget allows for one.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: I become a demon lord, and my first meeting is about leaks?
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: A wet throne breeds mold. Once the mold sets in, your authority gets slippery.
cues.STORY_D01_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: Fine. I'll protect the throne, protect my minions, and try to keep a grip on my authority.
cues.STORY_D01_PLACEMENT_FRONT_001: Next to Pudding! Gob be the not-squishy fist beside the squishy wall!
cues.STORY_D01_PLACEMENT_FRONT_002: Two of us means twice as much no getting through!
cues.STORY_D01_PLACEMENT_REAR_001: Next to Pynn! Gob hit anyone who dodges the fire!
cues.STORY_D01_PLACEMENT_REAR_002: Good. I grill, you flip. Perfect kitchen teamwork.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_001: Pudding belongs at the front. That's the best place to block the path with that body.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_002: Pudding's good at blocking! Paths, drafts... conversations too, if it's urgent!
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_003: Pynn fires from the rear. Put Pynn in front, and our backs are in more danger than the enemy.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_004: Safe distance secured. Now I just make their side unsafe, right?
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_005: Where does Gob go? Block in front? Hit from behind? Can't Gob do both?
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_006: I'll decide where Gob goes: beside Pudding to block the path, or beside Pynn for more firepower.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_007: The directive for everyone is Hold the Line. Today, learn to stay where you're posted.
cues.STORY_D01_PRECOMBAT_008: Got it. Gob hold position. But if position runs away, can Gob chase it?
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_01_001: Is this the suspicious hole I've heard about? Hello! Are you scheduled to collapse today?
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_01_002: It's not a hole! It's a demon lord's castle awaiting its exterior walls!
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_02_001: The intruder is Milo, an explorer. Plenty of curiosity. Rather less common sense.
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_02_002: Oh, a squishy wall in front and fire from the back. What an unusual welcome party.
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_03_001: Pudding's not a wall! Pudding's cuter and bouncier!
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_03_002: It is a welcome party. Your gift is a fireball. No exchanges or refunds.
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_04_001: One moment! I'm changing my report from 'Uneventful Cave' to 'Far Too Eventful Cave'!
cues.STORY_D01_COMBAT_TIME_04_002: Change that last word too. It's a castle, not a cave. Give it three stars!
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_001: Victory! A win on my very first day. I really was born to be a demon lord!
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_002: Strictly speaking, three minions fought while you cheered very loudly beside the throne.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_003: A commander's voice is a weapon. My throat is now a battle casualty.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_004: Accounts settled. Notoriety and gold are up a little. The cough-drop budget is down a little.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_005: We saved our home! That means it's really our home now, right?
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_006: Yes. Small and damp it may be, but if we defended it, it's our castle.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_007: Someone coming tomorrow too? Can Gob hit even more right now than today?
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_WIN_008: Word of the Treasury opening has leaked. Tomorrow's guest will care more about the safe than the front door.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_LOSS_001: The throne is broken. Our claim to the property is already shaky on day one.
cues.STORY_D01_RESULT_LOSS_002: I haven't even finished paying it off!
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: The Treasury is open. Its main selling point is that the nameplate looks more expensive than the contents.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: A Treasury! At last, a room worthy of a demon lord's castle.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: The current treasure consists of a few gold coins, a bundle of receipts, and your overdue maintenance bill.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: That last one isn't treasure. It's a classified document no one must ever find.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: Which is why I placed it at the back of the safe. Someone absolutely must find it eventually.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: Hi, rookie demon lord. Congrats on opening! I came to handle your first burglary.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: I'll accept the congratulations. You may even cut the ribbon. Just don't cut into the safe.
cues.STORY_D02_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: Six out of ten for the welcome speech. One bonus point for that cute panicked face.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_001: Nia will target the Treasury before the throne. Guard only the main route, and she may slip through.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_002: That safe holds every coin this castle owns.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_003: Every coin, and a considerable portion of my reason for existing.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_004: Gob catch the fast one! Gob fast too! Fists move before thoughts!
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_005: Doesn't that just mean your thoughts are slow?
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_006: Really? If Gob hit thoughts, do they get faster?
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_007: Pudding will block the path. Don't hit your thoughts. That sounds painful.
cues.STORY_D02_PRECOMBAT_008: Good. Lure her into the Spike Corridor. We'll explain our security policy to the soles of her feet!
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_01_001: The Treasury's my target. Thrones are heavy. Treasure is light.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_01_002: The throne is valuable too! That wasn't an invitation!
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_02_001: My lord, please stop explaining our asset inventory to the enemy.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_02_002: Thanks for the tip. I'll include the throne in my next estimate.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_03_001: Stop! Gob hasn't hit you yet!
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_03_002: If a thief stops when you ask, that's a customer waiting in line.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_04_001: Then I'll draw a line with fire. Take your hits in order, starting there.
cues.STORY_D02_COMBAT_TIME_04_002: Ow. Updating the security score. Cute and sloppy, but it stings more than expected.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_001: Treasure lost: zero. My heart nearly stopped from the shock.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_002: Treasure has been lost! The ledger entries are trembling. I have no hands, yet the handwriting trembles first!
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_004: Precisely. It safely completed zero beats.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_005: Seven points for today's security. Pretty good for a beginner.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_006: Eight points today. Your score went up with the coins I carried out.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_007: Drop 'beginner.' Try 'demon lord with terrifying growth potential.'
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_008: I could crack a safe in the time it takes to memorize that. I'll come play properly next time.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_009: You're welcome to visit. Just leave the money alone. I'll even make tea.
cues.STORY_D02_RESULT_WIN_010: There's no time for tea. Leon, an apprentice hero, is coming tomorrow without an appointment.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: Leon, the apprentice hero, is approaching. This will be the final defense of your introductory training.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: A hero at last. Bati, is my entrance speech ready?
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: Three lines prepared. I've also allowed for two and a half to be interrupted by combat.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: The Recovery Nest is open too. We chose 'nest' because 'medical bill' sounded terrifying.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: I labeled my fireball: 'To Justice, with heat.'
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: Are heroes really strong? If Pudding melts, can Pudding set again?
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: Fall back if you're in danger. Before we think about winning, I want everyone coming home.
cues.STORY_D03_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: Got it. Gob stay alive and hit lots. Gob good at both!
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_001: The Survival First directive sends endangered minions back toward the Recovery Nest.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_002: Retreat isn't cowardice. It's regrouping so you can boast for longer next time.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_003: I don't think two Recovery Nests could handle your ego.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_004: My ego regenerates naturally. It's in excellent health.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_005: Demon lord! In the name of justice, I have come to end your darkness!
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_006: He has beaten you to the entrance speech.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_007: He prepared lines too? The Heroes' Guild has excellent benefits.
cues.STORY_D03_PRECOMBAT_008: If they offer a speechwriting allowance, employment with the enemy merits consideration.
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_75_001: Demon Lord {{player_name}}! I am Leon, apprentice hero! I shall liberate this den of darkness!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_75_002: It's a castle, not a den. Small for now, but use the proper title!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_75_003: The hero manual lists evil strongholds as dens, caves, fortresses, et cetera!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_75_004: Don't lump us under 'et cetera'! We're moving up in the world!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_50_001: From out here, it looks like both of you grew your titles first. Your skills are still catching up.
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_50_002: Courage conquers traps! Ow! The manual didn't say how much they hurt!
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_25_001: Leon, if an apprentice can be a hero, a newcomer can be a demon lord. I'm not backing down.
cues.STORY_D03_COMBAT_BOSS_HP_25_002: Good. At least you're more than talk. Then I'm seeing this through too!
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_001: I lost. Next time, I'll add a whole entry about your castle to the manual.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_002: Title it 'Never Underestimate a Rookie Demon Lord.'
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_003: No. I'm going with 'A Small but Exceptionally Noisy Castle.'
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_004: We're all alive! Pudding's nice and bouncy again!
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_005: Yes. Winning is good, but having you back is better.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_006: Day three: apprentice hero repelled. We now have one piece of evidence for calling this cave a castle.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_007: Notoriety has risen sharply. Enough to attract both the Heroes' Guild and the tax office.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_WIN_008: Word spreads slowly if we only defend. Starting tomorrow, it's our turn to venture outside.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_LOSS_001: I did it! Though I feel a bit bad. That throne broke more easily than I expected.
cues.STORY_D03_RESULT_LOSS_002: That throne supported both my authority and my lower back!
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: Word of Leon's defeat is spreading. But notoriety will grow slowly if we simply wait here.
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: So we go to them? At last, I get to use the word 'invasion.'
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: Our first target is a signpost outside the village.
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: Say that again. I'm sure you meant 'fortress on the kingdom's frontier.'
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: A signpost, yes. A fortress would add three zeroes to our current budget.
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: Rolo, kobold scout captain, reporting! I handle finding paths, losing people, and inflating rumors!
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: Is that last one an official skill?
cues.STORY_D04_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: I put it in my report, so it is as of today!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_001: The goal is to turn it slightly, not destroy it. Make explorers take the wrong road toward our castle.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_002: My first expedition is a battle against a wooden plank.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_003: Don't underestimate it. It has two whole nails.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_004: You may take only one or two companions on this expedition. The others will guard the castle.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_005: One signpost, and we're already making staffing decisions.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_006: Good management begins with not sending everyone to do a small job.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_007: Very well! Today we turn a signpost. One day, we'll turn the kingdom's entire sense of direction upside down!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_008: If Gob hit it, does it turn?
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_009: Breaking it means failure. Today, use your wrist instead of your fist.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_010: I'm good at pushing things around. Push too hard and it might come out, though.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_011: Just turn it. Relocating the signpost can wait for the next expedition.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_012: Warm the nails a little, and it'll turn without much effort.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_ROSTER_013: Burn the sign too, and we'll get a compensation claim instead of control of the roads.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_001: No villagers in sight. Turn it now, and no one will know.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_002: A little to the left. Too far, and we won't find our way home either.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_003: A little... a little... How many hits is a little?
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_004: Don't hit it! Grab it and turn, like a doorknob!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_005: I only pushed a little, but I think the ground's moving too.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_006: Leave the ground! Our territory doesn't reach this far yet!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_007: Just heated the nails. Rolo can turn it now.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_008: Why didn't you cool the bit I have to hold?
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_009: Success! The 'Village' arrow now points toward our castle!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_010: More precisely, our castle is now impersonating a village.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_011: Excellent! Our castle's amenities now include zero residents and one throne!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_012: I filed the report under 'Operation: Seize the Kingdom's Transport Network'!
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_013: Actual cost: 5 food. Reported achievement: the entire kingdom. Very efficient.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_014: One little signpost will carry our name far and wide.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_015: For now, it will carry a few lost explorers in our direction.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_016: Being lost sounds scary. Can we give them directions before we hit them?
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_017: Any directions except the way to the throne. A friendly demon lord's castle has its charms.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_018: Stamping our seal on the forest supply crates could spread the rumors even further.
cues.STORY_D04_RAID_RESOLUTION_019: We'll consider that for tomorrow's expedition. First, let's welcome our lost guests.
cues.STORY_D04_DEFENSE_ARRIVAL_001: I followed the sign. Why does the village start with a Spike Corridor?
cues.STORY_D04_DEFENSE_ARRIVAL_002: Our transport policy's first customer! We'll take your satisfaction survey after the battle!
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_001: The signpost is working. Lost explorers are arriving later and farther apart than usual.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_002: Behold! Advanced tactics: turning the road itself into a weapon.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_003: Actually, our corridor map is slightly wrong too. Our scouts got lost twice yesterday.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_004: Don't tell the enemy. You'll ruin the mystique of advanced tactics.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_005: Today, you may also choose an expedition to stamp our castle's seal on supply crates.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_006: At last, we're interfering with the kingdom's supply network?
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_007: We won't steal the crates. Ink costs less than the expected proceeds from looting.
cues.STORY_D05_MANAGEMENT_ENTRY_008: Our invasion keeps operating on a stationery-shop scale. Is that really okay?
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_001: Excuse me! I'm sure I've passed this way before. Only the water stains look different!
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_002: Our castle's passages form a labyrinth that reflects the intruder's mind.
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_003: The builders connected the corridors incorrectly.
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_004: Don't tell the enemy that either.
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_005: Should Pudding show the lost people the exit?
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_006: Gob show them an entrance! Where Gob's fist comes in!
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_007: That's a declaration of war, not directions.
cues.STORY_D05_PRECOMBAT_008: Hold them off without getting hurt, and keep them from the throne. Today is our maze's first customer review!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_01_001: This room again! Even the squishy wall is exactly where it was!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_01_002: You remember Pudding? Still not getting through!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_02_001: I remember, but I wouldn't call this a happy reunion!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_02_002: Lost? Follow Gob! Gob doesn't know where Gob's going either!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_03_001: Don't follow Gob! That especially goes for our side!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_03_002: Exit's at the end of that corridor. Just a few fireballs along the way.
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_04_001: That's not an exit. That's a cooking process!
cues.STORY_D05_COMBAT_TIME_04_002: Now do you understand? Every path in this castle has a story!
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_001: I'll admit it. This place is small, but somehow long enough that I never want to come back.
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_002: 'Small, yet long.' The finest architectural review I've received today.
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_004: The village is already talking! 'Don't trust the signs' and 'Watch out for the demon lord's castle' at the same time!
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_005: Two rumors from one signpost. An excellent return on investment.
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_006: Nobody reached the throne today either. Our home's paths did a good job!
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_007: Yes. Twisted as they are, to our friends, they're still the way home.
cues.STORY_D05_RESULT_WIN_008: A note from Nia. She says she'll reassess Treasury security tomorrow.
cues.STORY_D05_RAID_RESULT_001: Every supply crate has our seal! One's upside down, but it looked more suspicious, so I left it!
cues.STORY_D05_RAID_RESULT_002: The kingdom will likely mistake this for an organized attack on its supply network.
cues.STORY_D05_RAID_RESULT_003: One stamp, and suddenly we're an organization. The kingdom thinks more highly of us than we do.
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_001: Congratulations, my lord. A letter has arrived from the kingdom.
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_003: An extermination warning. Goodwill traveling in quite the opposite direction.
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_004: Fine royal stationery. We could sell it for two copper coins.
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_005: It puts a bounty on my head, and your first thought is selling the paper?
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_006: The bounty barely competes with the paper's value. We may as well salvage something.
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_007: Isn't it pinned up upside down, though?
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_008: Maybe someone flipped it for Gob, since he can't read anyway.
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_009: I know this! The royal seal goes at the bottom, so this end goes up!
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_010: I put it up that way. Got glue on my hands while copying it.
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_011: Anyway, if the kingdom is warning us personally, we must be getting famous.
cues.STORY_D11_MANAGEMENT_012: Famous, yes. Whether we can survive that fame is what we must prove from today onward.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_001: Copies of the warning went up on three more guild boards. It won't just be explorers this time.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_002: The investigator will inspect the Entrance, Barracks, and Treasury in order. Thieves will follow.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_003: What if we rename all the rooms? The Treasury becomes storage. The throne becomes the toilet.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_004: The moment the Treasury becomes a toilet, I resign.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_005: So you're fine with using the throne as one.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_006: I'm even less fine with that.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_007: The kingdom really is coming to get us, isn't it?
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_008: We're still doing what we've always done. Stop the invaders and hold our positions for each other.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_009: I'll stick to scouting. If I join the battle now, I'm sure I'll be the first to fall, map and all.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_010: Just show me the way. I'll do the running.
cues.STORY_D11_PRECOMBAT_012: Kingdom Investigator Iris. Commencing the first site inspection since the warning was issued.
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_01_001: Entrance is narrow. One slime occupies most of the passage.
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_01_002: Most? I've actually lost a little lately.
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_02_001: Less chatter! Two purple hoods are heading for the vault!
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_02_002: The warning never mentioned a Spike Corridor!
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_02_003: The kingdom wrote the warning! Why complain to me?
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_02_004: Treasury location confirmed. Defenders pursue immediately.
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_03_001: Not immediately enough. Kindly pursue more immediately!
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_03_002: Don't worry! I'll follow that hood until it feels like his own front door!
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_03_003: No more waves. Just stop the thieves already inside.
cues.STORY_D11_COMBAT_03_004: Good. Rolo watches the routes, Gob gives chase, and Pudding and Pynn hold the front. Let's finish this our way.
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_001: Inspection complete. Reclassifying this site from 'ordinary cave' to 'potential official threat.'
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_002: We won. Why does moving up the ranks feel worse?
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_003: Because you correctly understand it means stronger enemies.
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_004: Gold losses are modest, too. Today, at least, we can afford to frame the warning.
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_005: Hang it over the Demon Lord's bed. A fresh sense of peril every morning.
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_007: Still, no one will call this place just a hole anymore, right?
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_008: Right. The entrance you held and every room we protected are all part of our Demon Castle.
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_009: Then I'll be this castle's eyes. Even if I can't fight, I can spot trouble and make it back.
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_010: Just don't fall over. I'm the only one left to pick up your map.
cues.STORY_D11_RESULT_WIN_012: The kingdom took today's battle records. Tomorrow, we should strengthen one of our own first.
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_001: I've reviewed yesterday's battle. Starting today, we can promote one minion ahead of the others.
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_002: Finally, a transformation? Bigger wings, shining armor, thunder rumbling with every entrance?
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_003: Their role and abilities improve first. Thunder is not in the budget.
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_004: Natural phenomena have high maintenance costs.
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_005: If I get stronger first, I can hold the entrance longer.
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_006: If it's me, thieves won't even see the Treasury door.
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_007: If it's me, every investigator's report turns to ash.
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_008: Why must I make this choice with all three of you standing right in front of me?
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_009: Choosing behind their backs would hurt more.
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_010: Right. And I'd find out anyway.
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_011: You can sniff out the mood as well as the vault?
cues.STORY_D12_MANAGEMENT_012: Whoever goes first, we'll all get stronger eventually, right?
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_001: Right. We're choosing the role we need first, not deciding who's most precious.
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_002: That's all I needed to hear. Whoever goes first can show the rest of us the way.
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_003: Even if I'm not picked, I'll catch the thieves. That's already my job.
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_004: My fire won't get weaker, either. Just a little less spectacular.
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_005: Today's battle tests your chosen role: holding the front, pursuit, or firepower.
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_006: Thieves arrive late in the battle. Do not abandon the vault to celebrate a promotion.
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_007: Don't worry. As of today, our Demon Castle is an organization dedicated to developing talent.
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_008: Three employees yesterday. A talent development organization today.
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_009: Wait. You said promotion. Why hasn't anyone become enormous?
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_010: Why are you suddenly being so polite?
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_011: The manual was revised. We must show respect to opponents listed in official warnings.
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_012: You changed your hairstyle a little and called yourself stronger!
cues.STORY_D12_PRECOMBAT_013: That was the result of training!
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_01_001: Promoted individual confirmed. No visible change. Measuring any increase in combat efficiency.
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_01_002: Don't reduce someone's growth to numbers.
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_01_003: We use numbers too. We simply remember to use their names as well.
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_01_004: I'll hold the front. Whoever got promoted, focus on your own position!
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_02_001: Two thieves coming in late! They're using our celebration to rob the vault!
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_02_002: We heard the party snacks were gold coins.
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_02_004: Then we'll have to cancel. Goldin is far too healthy today.
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_03_001: Even with only one stronger minion, the battle line has changed.
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_03_002: When one moves ahead, the other two have a path to follow.
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_03_003: Then next time, I shall return stronger than today's records suggest.
cues.STORY_D12_COMBAT_03_004: Read the route as well as the report. Don't get lost near the vault again.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_001: The first promotion was a success. The chosen role made a clear difference in battle.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_002: I'm glad everyone took it better than I expected.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_005: Kidding. But if you're that worried, take my candidacy seriously next time.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_006: I got picked first, and I'm still a little hurt.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_008: If I was going to be this good, you should've picked me sooner.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_009: The promoted one gets an extra snack today. Double training tomorrow, though.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_010: Is that a celebration or a punishment?
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_011: One snack for twice the training is excellent value.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_012: The one who stepped ahead and the two who held their ground behind them all did well today.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_013: You are finally giving performance reviews worthy of a Demon Lord.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_014: The kingdom is moving new equipment. A shield bigger than a person.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_015: If the shield is bigger than the door... can it even get through?
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_016: Now that I'm tougher, I'll hold the front for the other two as well.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_017: From today on, thieves who spot me will look for the exit before the vault.
cues.STORY_D12_RESULT_WIN_018: I won't even give them time to write. Their eyes will be burning before the paper does.
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_001: That new soldier's shield really is bigger than his body. He's a walking door.
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_002: A door is coming through our door?
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_003: If it won't fit, tell him to wait outside.
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_004: Shieldbearers are slow but durable. They pin down the front line so troops behind them can move.
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_005: Slow enemies keep hitting longer. Longer hitting means longer breaking, and longer breaking means longer repair bills.
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_008: If the kingdom prepared that after reading about my promotion... did I make things worse by getting stronger first?
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_009: The enemy prepares because we keep surviving. You need not shoulder that responsibility alone.
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_010: Right. If they prepare, we beat them again.
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_011: Besides, that shield looks more flammable than you'd think.
cues.STORY_D13_MANAGEMENT_012: You getting stronger isn't the problem. What matters is how we use that strength together.
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_001: One shieldbearer will tie up the front while an investigator studies us from behind. Keep an eye out for late thieves.
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_002: If I can't go through the shield, I'll go around it.
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_003: High probability of goblin avoiding a frontal engagement.
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_005: The report will say 'ran away sideways.'
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_006: It's not running away if I didn't go backward!
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_007: It'll make an awfully loud noise when I hit that shield, won't it?
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_008: Don't worry. You're heav... I mean, tougher.
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_009: You were going to say heavier, weren't you?
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_010: The kingdom's troops are here! Focus on the battle!
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_011: Royal inspection force! Stay behind the shield!
cues.STORY_D13_PRECOMBAT_012: His voice is as big as his shield. Shutting him up might take a while.
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_01_001: He's really tough! He keeps coming even when I push!
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_01_002: Holding him is enough. You need not defeat him alone.
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_01_003: Pudding has him pinned. I'll burn the flank.
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_01_004: And I'll handle the investigator hiding behind him!
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_02_001: Shield bypass confirmed. Goblin movement prediction requires revision.
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_02_002: Want me to do another lap while you write?
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_02_003: Not another lap! Go to the Treasury! A thief is inside!
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_02_004: That big shield does a fine job of keeping everyone distracted.
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_03_001: Did you lot have a strategy meeting?
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_03_002: Different royal departments. We don't meet much.
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_03_003: That's a bit too realistic to be funny.
cues.STORY_D13_COMBAT_03_004: This isn't an enemy who came because of me. It's our next challenge together. I won't give ground here.
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_001: Shieldbearer countermeasures successful. This troop type favors staying power over speed.
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_002: He moved so slowly. Why were we busier?
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_003: Enemies who break things slowly are the most expensive.
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_004: Still, no big deal once I got behind him.
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_005: Goblin circles sideways on seeing a shield.
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_007: Ask her to let you write it in the report yourself next time.
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_009: With everyone fighting beside me, it didn't feel like I was being tested alone.
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_010: Whoever gets stronger next, we face every test together.
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_011: We will hold off on a second promotion for now. Instead, we must prepare to expand the castle itself.
cues.STORY_D13_RESULT_WIN_012: Tomorrow, we discuss something terrifying: castle upgrade costs.
cues.STORY_D14_MANAGEMENT_001: The Lesser Demon Castle promotion review costs 720 gold and 720 Infamy.
cues.STORY_D14_MANAGEMENT_002: Wait. We pay Infamy too? Where do we even keep it?
cues.STORY_D14_MANAGEMENT_004: If we spend Infamy, do people get less scared of us?
cues.STORY_D14_MANAGEMENT_005: One good shout from you should fill it right back up.
cues.STORY_D14_MANAGEMENT_008: Please don't calculate that. My resolve is weakening.
cues.STORY_D14_MANAGEMENT_009: The castle will not transform today. Today, we protect the funds and earn the right to tomorrow's review.
cues.STORY_D14_MANAGEMENT_010: So we pay, but the walls stay the same?
cues.STORY_D14_MANAGEMENT_011: Keeping today's money is how we change tomorrow's walls.
cues.STORY_D14_MANAGEMENT_012: My lord, wouldn't it be cheaper to write 'Lesser Demon Castle' on the wall ourselves?
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_001: I refuse to be a Demon Lord who advances by putting up a fake sign.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_002: All the more moving from the man who wanted to rename his throne the toilet yesterday.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_004: Two thieves follow the investigator and shieldbearer. Every gold coin carries extra weight today.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_005: Heavy money should slow thieves down.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_006: The moment they steal it, they become remarkably fast.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_007: I'll hold the front. Gob, watch the vault right to the end.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_008: I'll handle the investigator. An overly detailed review report would be a nuisance.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_009: Beginning preliminary documentation of the Lesser Demon Castle candidate site.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_011: If tomorrow's examiner reaches your throne, you will be disqualified.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_012: Then put this in big letters today: 'Tomorrow's assault will also fail.'
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_013: Money matters, but what happens to the review if someone gets hurt defending it?
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_014: We can earn the money again. Don't abandon each other just to protect the ledger.
cues.STORY_D14_PRECOMBAT_015: As treasurer, I object. As a member of this castle's family... I agree.
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_01_001: Hold the front! Give the investigator time to record!
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_01_002: Add one thing: the sides of shields burn beautifully.
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_01_003: I'm not giving ground! Just getting... a little flatter!
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_02_001: Yes! I'm round anyway, so no one can tell!
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_02_002: Thieves approaching the rear! They aren't carrying off gold. They're carrying tomorrow's walls!
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_02_003: It's a few coins. Why make such a big deal of it?
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_02_004: Think of those pockets as full of castle walls today!
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_03_002: So put them down and leave!
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_03_003: Defenders' fixation on the vault: extremely high.
cues.STORY_D14_COMBAT_03_004: We're protecting tomorrow, not just a vault. Stop every last one!
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_001: The battle is over. Now I shall recount our remaining gold and Infamy.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_002: Both meet the requirement. Tomorrow's review can proceed.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_003: All we did was keep our money. Why does it feel like beating a boss?
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_004: An actual boss arrives tomorrow. Do not spend that feeling prematurely.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_005: One total has fallen below the requirement. We cannot begin tomorrow's review in this state.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_006: We won the battle but lost our reserves. We'll rebuild them. We're not giving up on growing here.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_007: Your eligibility is deferred, not lost. Restore the required amounts and we can proceed.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_008: Even feelings have a budget here.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_009: Will our rooms really change if we pass?
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_010: Yes. Along with the walls and floors, the kingdom's view of this place will change.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_011: Do I get my own room?
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_012: The shared quarters get new wallpaper.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_014: Give it time. Someday, I'll give each of you a room with your name on it.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_015: White armor approaching. Sword in one hand, incredibly thick checklist in the other.
cues.STORY_D14_RESULT_WIN_016: Selen, a paladin in training. Tomorrow, her checklist will be more troublesome than her sword.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_001: Selen, paladin in training and temporary Lesser Demon Castle examiner. I shall proceed according to the checklist.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_002: Don't bosses usually draw their swords while introducing themselves?
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_003: Drawing a sword before confirming identities is a procedural violation.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_004: An enemy with a sound grasp of the basics.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_005: Item one: presence of throne. Item two: presence of Demon Lord. Item three: marked emergency exits.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_006: Why does a Demon Castle need emergency exits?
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_007: Because Demon Lords must evacuate during fires too.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_008: The first examiner to take me seriously.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_009: Do not start planning a fire.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_010: And item seventeen: slip resistance in front of the throne.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_011: I pass through a lot, so it might be a little slippery.
cues.STORY_D15_MANAGEMENT_012: Pudding, let's stay still. Just for today.
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_001: Selen enters late. Deal with the investigator, shieldbearer, and thieves first.
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_002: Senior Hero Leon's report said, 'Small, but surprisingly heavy on procedures.'
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_003: He broke into my home. How did he find time to write so much?
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_004: Also, 'Prolonged verbal disputes in front of the throne.'
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_007: Clear the thieves out fast, and there won't be time for a checklist.
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_008: Do not confiscate the checklist. Lost review documents mean another review.
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_009: We have to protect her paperwork while fighting her?
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_010: Becoming an official castle is an irritating business.
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_011: Preliminary checks complete. I will now test throne accessibility in live combat.
cues.STORY_D15_PRECOMBAT_012: Good. You've brought your paperwork and your sword. Take a defeat home with you too.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_01_001: I've stopped the shieldbearer! But Selen is coming in behind him!
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_01_002: Check for thieves between the waves first. Watch only the boss, and the vault will be empty.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_01_003: Everyone's busy entertaining guests on inspection day.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_01_004: You're not on the guest list!
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_02_001: Checklist item twenty-three: rear security during combat.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_02_002: We are currently passing that item! Gob, faster!
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_02_003: I can see a gap in Selen's armor. Pudding, hold her for three more steps.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_02_004: Just three steps? That's nice and short today!
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_03_001: Slime adhesion exceeds the report's estimate.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_03_002: Leon always leaves out the important bits.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_03_003: Shield unit, go around the fallen soldiers! Do not step on them!
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_03_004: The shortest route is straight ahead.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_04_001: We can revise a checklist when we get home alive. We do not use the wounded as a road.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_04_002: Then I shall make the corrections myself.
cues.STORY_D15_COMBAT_04_003: Write whatever you like. Just don't leave out anything this castle teaches you!
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_001: Combat assessment complete. Throne not reached. Defensive coordination maintained.
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_002: The Treasury is intact as well. Rear defenses pass.
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_003: I will record the lost treasure. Throne defense and front-line coordination still meet the passing criteria.
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_005: Yes. You have met the requirements for promotion to a Lesser Demon Castle.
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_008: Do we have to go over that again?
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_009: The floor has changed too. It really doesn't feel like a cave anymore.
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_011: Improvement recommended. Not grounds for failure.
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_012: Selen, thanks for giving us a fair assessment, even as our enemy.
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_013: Being enemies makes accuracy more important. Next time, I come to vanquish you, not examine you.
cues.STORY_D15_RESULT_WIN_014: A map of the kingdom's supply routes is tucked between the checklist pages Selen dropped.
cues.STORY_D16_MANAGEMENT_001: Found a supply map in Selen's checklist. Royal wagons take two different routes.
cues.STORY_D16_MANAGEMENT_002: Could she have dropped it as a trap?
cues.STORY_D16_MANAGEMENT_003: There's a lunch-soup stain on the corner. This wasn't staged.
cues.STORY_D16_MANAGEMENT_004: So Selen works through lunch too.
cues.STORY_D16_MANAGEMENT_005: Ridge scouting is safe, with modest rewards. Raiding the riverside depot yields more gold and Infamy.
cues.STORY_D16_MANAGEMENT_009: Scouting diverts one investigator onto an empty route and delays every enemy. The depot yields loot, but one thief follows us home.
cues.STORY_D16_MANAGEMENT_010: So we can prepare safely, or take a risk to bring something home first.
cues.STORY_D16_MANAGEMENT_011: You found the map. I want your opinion first.
cues.STORY_D16_MANAGEMENT_012: I can make either work. What matters is the risk our castle can handle today.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_001: The raid party has returned. Now we must connect the routes they changed to our defenses.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_002: I made the choice, but they made it work. Let's defend this place so nobody's efforts go to waste.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_003: Scouting protected the ledger. Raiding filled it. Either way, we must not let anyone steal it now.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_004: Always comes back to the ledger.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_005: The torch sequence matches the map. The investigator took the empty detour, and the others are late too.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_007: If you miss them that much, jingle some gold in your pocket on the next raid.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_008: Use the delayed arrival to organize the front line.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_009: Raid proceeds received. A rare smile has appeared in the ledger.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_010: But one thief followed the scent of the wagon wheels. Doesn't even seem to be hiding.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_011: Good. My feet were itching for a run.
cues.STORY_D16_PRECOMBAT_012: An extra thief follows the regular patrol. Do not leave the Treasury unguarded.
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_01_001: The bigger castle has wider corridors, but the enemies seem more confident too!
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_01_002: A bigger castle calls for more dignified ways of showing guests out.
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_01_004: Give them a warm and courteous reception.
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_02_002: I already know who's coming behind you today!
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_02_003: They're even later than expected. Reading the route first really changes a battle.
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_02_004: Good work, Rolo. Your map held this front before the fighting even started.
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_03_001: While the investigator is away, I'll burn anything worth recording.
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_03_002: Exactly as Rolo mapped it. Forget the investigator on the empty road and push back the patrol before us.
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_03_003: Who couldn't follow a wagon making that much noise?
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_03_004: The pursuit expenses will be deducted from your salary.
cues.STORY_D16_COMBAT_04_002: I'll process your resignation right away!
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_001: By acting on the routes first, we made them approach on our terms.
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_002: We're not just a castle that waits for attacks anymore.
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_003: It's also the first time we went out and everyone came home safely.
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_004: My map really helped in battle.
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_005: Of course it did. Without you watching the routes, I'm just someone who gets lost fast.
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_007: That's growth. Doesn't that deserve a promotion?
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_008: There is no budget for promoting our scout yet.
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_009: Budget or not, Rolo led today's operation. Well done.
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_010: Next time, I'll find a map without soup on it.
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_011: A bigger castle and raiding parties too? Time to test that vault security again.
cues.STORY_D16_RESULT_WIN_012: Every time I hear that voice, my ledger's lifespan gets shorter.
cues.STORY_D17_MANAGEMENT_001: Good morning, Demon Castle security team.
cues.STORY_D17_MANAGEMENT_002: We are the security team. You are the security incident.
cues.STORY_D17_MANAGEMENT_003: If the incident brings its own improvement plan, shouldn't it charge a consulting fee?
cues.STORY_D17_MANAGEMENT_005: This won't end with one attempt. The second thief goes in the moment you relax after stopping the first.
cues.STORY_D17_MANAGEMENT_007: Only two to count. No wonder you understood so fast.
cues.STORY_D17_MANAGEMENT_009: So we mustn't leave our positions after the first break-in, right?
cues.STORY_D17_MANAGEMENT_010: Correct. Just as you catch your breath after stopping one thief, the second enters.
cues.STORY_D17_MANAGEMENT_011: Do not celebrate after one interception. The vault must survive twice today.
cues.STORY_D17_MANAGEMENT_012: Stop both, and I'll personally rate your security.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_001: Is it normal for a thief to rate someone else's vault?
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_002: Customers rate restaurants, not the chefs.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_003: Our vault is not a restaurant.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_004: It keeps getting emptied. More of a buffet.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_005: Pynn, I am deducting one spark from your pay today.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_006: I see a purple hood, I chase it. First or second, doesn't matter.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_007: I'll hold the front after the first break-in too. I'll keep Gob's return route open.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_008: Good. This isn't a test of one person guarding the vault. We're testing how well we relieve each other.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_009: I like that. In a good vault, the people move before the door does.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_010: A brief front-line clash precedes the first thief. An investigator arrives between the two infiltrations.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_011: If Gob stops to watch the fighting at the entrance after catching the first, we lose the second.
cues.STORY_D17_PRECOMBAT_012: It happened once! Are you bringing it up forever?
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_01_001: Here comes the first! Just a preview!
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_01_003: Wait. Why is the goblin waiting here instead of at the entrance?
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_01_004: Because I scouted the route in advance.
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_02_001: First break-in stopped. Stay in position!
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_02_002: Defender redeployment confirmed. Recording possible routes for the second infiltration.
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_02_003: Don't peek at our answers during the test.
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_02_004: I'll stop the investigator here! Gob, keep watching the rear!
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_03_001: Can you hear the second set of footsteps?
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_03_002: Yes. Heavier feet than the first one!
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_03_003: How can you tell just from footsteps?
cues.STORY_D17_COMBAT_03_004: You speed up when you think about gold!
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_001: Keeping your guard up through both attempts was pretty good.
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_003: Doors, pursuit speed, actual losses. I need the whole picture first.
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_004: Both left empty-handed. Even Goldin might enjoy reading this report card.
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_005: You chased them to the end, but they didn't leave empty-handed. I'll mark the missed interception on your report card.
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_006: I never imagined waiting for a thief to send us a report card.
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_007: If the grades are low, do we get a parent-teacher meeting?
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_009: The one sitting on the throne?
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_010: My lord, are you our guardian?
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_011: Guardian, I don't know... but I'm definitely the first person to get angry if you get hurt.
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_012: Then we'll take the next test together too.
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_013: I didn't set the next test. Royal blockade troops are following my infiltration records.
cues.STORY_D17_RESULT_WIN_014: Tomorrow, we must choose between cutting off the thieves' route and disrupting the kingdom's records.
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_001: Royal blockade troops are tightening their grip on both the customs-ledger route and the smuggling tunnel.
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_003: If we tackle both, our party will not make it home.
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_004: Plant a fake ledger, and the investigator goes to an empty depot. Both thieves still come, though.
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_005: Collapse the tunnel, and one thief turns back. But the kingdom will fill the gap with a shieldbearer.
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_007: Lucky you can count to two.
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_008: Why have numbers been attacking me since yesterday?
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_009: Two thieves threaten our treasure. Two shieldbearers threaten our repair budget. Both options are bad for me.
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_010: But we can choose the one we're better at stopping.
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_011: Would you be all right with us blocking a tunnel you use?
cues.STORY_D18_MANAGEMENT_012: I can find another route. Right now, I hate the kingdom using that one more.
cues.STORY_D18_PRECOMBAT_001: Good. There's no perfectly safe answer. We leave the threat we can handle.
cues.STORY_D18_PRECOMBAT_002: The route we cut off will change the faces coming through our front gate today.
cues.STORY_D18_PRECOMBAT_003: And the kingdom will see what we did. Tomorrow's reinforcements might change too.
cues.STORY_D18_PRECOMBAT_004: One choice tormenting two days of ledgers.
cues.STORY_D18_PRECOMBAT_005: I copied the investigator's seal, but the handwriting is a little strange.
cues.STORY_D18_PRECOMBAT_007: The crown in 'Crown Property' looks like an octopus.
cues.STORY_D18_PRECOMBAT_008: Investigators trust seals more than handwriting. The two thieves trust their noses and will come anyway.
cues.STORY_D18_PRECOMBAT_009: I put an 'Under Construction' sign by the tunnel too.
cues.STORY_D18_PRECOMBAT_012: Tunnel blocked, late thief turned back. Two shieldbearers are coming to the front gate instead.
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_01_001: Whichever we chose, I'll hold the front!
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_01_002: Watch roles, not just numbers! Remember which threat we left ourselves today!
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_01_004: Even after death, Goldin will haunt the vault.
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_02_001: The fake ledger worked! The investigator went to the empty depot!
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_02_002: You can fool the royal seal, but you can't fool our noses.
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_02_003: I know. That's why I was watching your ankles before your nose!
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_02_004: The thieves come in two waves. Reset your position after the first pursuit.
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_03_001: Reinforce the gate line to compensate for the tunnel force!
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_03_002: That shield's caught in the doorframe!
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_03_003: Don't help push it through. It's easiest to defend against right there.
cues.STORY_D18_COMBAT_03_004: There is only one thief. Focus first on the strengthened front line.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_001: By adjusting our defense to the enemy roles we chose, we broke through the blockade.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_002: Choosing which enemies to leave is harder than simply reducing their numbers.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_003: Knowing that means you're no beginner anymore. A thief doesn't always steal the most expensive thing either.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_004: Then may I recommend choosing to steal nothing from now on?
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_005: Can't. That would undermine my professional identity.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_006: Thank you for even telling us where the tunnel was.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_007: Save the thanks. I just hated seeing the kingdom treat my routes as its own.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_008: Whatever your reasons, your information helped us defend this place. I'll remember that.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_009: Suit yourself. No bonus points on your security rating, though.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_010: Strict even when you're on our side.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_011: The blockade troops dropped an order as they retreated. The problem is, we picked up the original.
cues.STORY_D18_RESULT_WIN_012: Then tomorrow, they will come to take that paper back.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_001: The original blockade order we picked up yesterday is in the Treasury now.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_002: Why put one sheet of paper in the vault?
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_003: Beside the gold is the safest place.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_004: A 'Very Boring Document' sign would've been safer.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_005: Right. I'd never have opened it.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_006: You don't open anything with writing on it.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_007: Today's thief wants the order before the gold. A recovery captain follows late in the battle.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_008: A thief who ignores gold? Questionable professional ethics.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_009: Some days the kingdom pays more for paper than gold.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_010: If we chose the fake ledger yesterday, the vanguard has more investigators. If we blocked the tunnel, it has more shields.
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_011: But the recovery thief and captain coming afterward are the same, right?
cues.STORY_D19_MANAGEMENT_012: Correct. Do not exhaust yourselves against the opening line.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_001: Counter the opening troops based on yesterday's choice. Gob, save some strength for the late pursuit.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_002: A paper thief is still a thief.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_003: When you catch one, ask for reading lessons.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_004: Time to get ready for battle!
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_005: The recovery thief is faster than a regular vault robber. Grab the target and get out, that's the plan.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_006: Then I shall carry it myself.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_007: Goldin's running speed does not qualify as a security measure.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_009: Last time, you fell behind picking up your dropped ledger.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_010: I could not abandon the ledger.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_011: Today, we'll protect both the paper and Goldin.
cues.STORY_D19_PRECOMBAT_012: Vanguard, recovery thief, then recovery captain. Be sure to reposition after the first clash.
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_01_001: Opening vanguard entering! Their formation reflects the traces we left yesterday!
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_01_002: Cut off the threats we expected. Keep troops in the rear!
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_01_003: The front's still fine! Gob, return to the vault approach!
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_01_004: Can't I finish off that formation first?
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_02_001: No. Those next footsteps aren't front-line troops. One breath, and the recovery thief is in.
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_02_003: Leave the gold! Recover the order only!
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_02_004: Why does leaving the gold sound so insulting?
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_03_001: Be insulted later. The recovery captain is coming too.
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_03_002: Recovery captain approaching. Return troops to the entrance line as they finish the pursuit.
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_03_003: Gob, come back! Pudding, hold one more step! Pynn, focus your fire on the captain!
cues.STORY_D19_COMBAT_03_004: Paper protected. Now I'll fold up your pride and send that back too!
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_001: Blockade order secured. The kingdom's tracking route has also been cut off.
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_002: No losses beyond one crumpled corner.
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_003: The whole castle turned upside down over one sheet of paper.
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_005: Don't turn our bedroom into the kingdom's document archive.
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_006: Good call keeping pursuit troops back instead of falling for the opening line.
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_007: I know how to wait now.
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_009: That's a long time in battle!
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_010: You came back at exactly the right time today, though.
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_011: I found the supply officer's signature on the back of the order. The name is Roman.
cues.STORY_D19_RESULT_WIN_012: Field report forms are being damaged repeatedly. I will conduct the next inspection myself.
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_001: I investigated Barracks and Watch Post operating times before records of attacks on the throne.
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_002: You even recorded when we use our facilities?
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_003: There was an item on the checklist.
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_004: Today, two sappers will target different facilities and temporarily shut them down.
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_005: Do we still pay upkeep while a facility is disabled?
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_007: Kill the sappers first. This is a personal request.
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_008: Roman, royal supply officer. The existing field report forms contain too many errors, so I have come to check personally.
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_009: A boss comes to fight us and starts by complaining about forms?
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_010: A sword swing ends. A bad form lives on throughout the department.
cues.STORY_D20_MANAGEMENT_012: What do I do against a boss who attacks with writing?
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_001: The first sapper breaks off toward a facility. As the line wavers, the second targets another room. Watch their direction.
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_002: If we miss one, does the facility stay shut down?
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_003: No. The shutdown wears off after a while. But the front line suffers in the meantime.
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_004: If it's not out forever, we can light it again.
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_006: Planning to hide behind sappers and drag this out?
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_007: Not 'hide.' 'Maintain command position.' Surviving royal troops will receive healing and protective supplies.
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_008: Everything he says sounds like a report.
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_009: Everything you say sounds like a scribble. It balances out.
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_010: Gob pursues when the sappers split. Pudding holds the line. Pynn focuses Roman the moment the command line opens.
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_011: You are watching the order of battle, not just individual enemies.
cues.STORY_D20_PRECOMBAT_012: Today, we're protecting the whole castle, not just one room.
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_01_001: The first sapper has left the front. Watch which room he approaches.
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_01_003: Fill out a usage request before touching our facilities!
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_02_001: The shieldbearer's on me! I'll hold him until Gob returns!
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_02_002: That one's already disabled! Moving to another room!
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_02_003: They're splitting up. My lord, which one first?
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_02_004: Protect the facility keeping our front alive! Hold out until the one we missed comes back online!
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_03_001: Joining the command line shortly. Wound reports and defensive supplies will be redistributed using my forms.
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_03_002: You need a form for healing?
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_03_003: Those who fail to complete it are ineligible.
cues.STORY_D20_COMBAT_03_004: Then add this to your form: 'Demon Castle returns supply officer to sender.'
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_001: Sapper contact lost, protective supplies exhausted, command line collapsed... the numbers do not add up.
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_002: Battles don't always end the way the ledger says.
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_003: Indeed. This is not a temporary lair, but a self-sustaining combat stronghold.
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_004: You cut enemy supplies while keeping your own line alive. Your management was far more accurate than the reports.
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_005: And you withdrew your troops before collapsing. Experienced administrators recognize such things in each other.
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_006: An enemy, but an accurate accountant.
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_009: Recruiting a prisoner violates royal labor regulations.
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_011: My lord, the castle is moving! The walls and facilities are all changing!
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_012: The Battle Fortress has awakened. The kingdom will now classify this place as a citadel-level threat.
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_013: I didn't grow alone. Pudding held firm, Gob ran, Pynn kept the fire going. Everyone brought this castle to life.
cues.STORY_D20_RESULT_WIN_014: Keep the celebration short. Selen's banner is on the ridge. This time, she's bringing an army instead of a checklist.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_001: Roman's sappers withdrew last night. But a familiar name heads today's invader list.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_002: Don't tell me Roman is coming back with his ledger.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_003: If he brings his ledger, it is a joint audit, not a battle. I would rather face a sword.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_004: Selen. Registered as a field commander this time, rather than an examiner.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_005: Your troops switched targets faster than our sappers could disable them. Today, I will command that opening myself.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_006: Catch one commander and everyone slows down? Easy answer. I'll run over and catch her.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_007: Who holds the front while you run off?
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_008: I'll hold it on the way back.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_009: An impressively fast absence of a plan.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_010: Royal troops move and attack faster while Selen lives. Gob's plan is dangerous, but not incorrect.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_011: Then we must decide: hold the line or cut Selen down first.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_012: Do faster enemies make repair bills pile up faster too?
