cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_013: Our billing speed is already exceptional.
cues.STORY_D21_MANAGEMENT_014: At least our invoices have reached Grand Demon Castle level.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_001: The advance explorers enter first. Selen follows them in.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_002: Don't spend everything at the start. Save strength to pursue Selen when she appears.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_003: Got it. Only half excited for now.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_004: Half your usual is everyone else's full sprint.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_005: I'll pin down the front. I'll open a gap for Gob to pass through.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_006: First time you've offered that yourself.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_007: And today, I'll try believing you when you say you'll come back.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_008: Vanguard, pin the demon line. Increase speed as soon as I enter.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_009: An army that only speeds up with someone pushing from behind? Its commander must be busy.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_010: Better than an army that runs wherever it likes and gets stuck in doorways.
cues.STORY_D21_PRECOMBAT_013: Reconcile your memories after the battle. Selen is nearly here.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_01_001: Selen's command mark is active. The entire royal force is accelerating.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_01_002: Shield unit, hold the front. Explorers, advance through the open branch.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_01_003: Gob, go after Selen. Pudding, hold the shieldbearer. Pynn, shoot behind the shield.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_01_004: Finally! Time to get fully excited!
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_02_001: I know that shield is heavy, but why are you leaning on me?
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_02_002: I have to lean forward so I don't get pushed back!
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_02_004: Hold still, Pudding. I've got an angle over the shield.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_03_001: You split pursuit from the front line on the spot. Faster reactions than Roman's report suggested.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_03_002: Reports describe yesterday's castle. We're still changing today.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_03_003: Shieldbearer arriving shortly. Block Gob's approach.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_03_004: Oh, a doorman just for me?
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_04_001: Defeat him, and I will consider a special allowance.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_04_004: One more late explorer is joining, followed by an investigator.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_05_001: If Selen's command remains active, record retrieval will be faster too.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_05_002: Don't let this drag on. Finish Selen first.
cues.STORY_D21_COMBAT_05_004: Selen's right side is exposed. Now.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_001: Selen's command mark has gone dark. The royal troops' enhancement has ended.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_002: All troops, retreat. We have enough records for today.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_003: If it's enough, you don't have to come back.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_004: Enough to show how dangerous you are. If anything, more will come.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_005: Your checklist used to bore me. Today, you were sharp.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_006: Your orders used to be all bluster. Today, they had life in them.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_007: They were complimenting each other, right?
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_008: They both make compliments sound like attacks.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_009: If we classify them as attacks, can they count toward our successful-defense allowance?
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_011: A second beacon has been lit on the northern watchtower. Royal reconnaissance is moving to the next phase.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_013: Today they tested advance speed. Tomorrow they will record our rotation times and facility blind spots.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_014: Let them write. I'll run a different route every time.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_015: That's not a plan. That's what you already do.
cues.STORY_D21_RESULT_WIN_016: And as those battle records accumulate, the second promotion review will open. Tomorrow's defense earns our next growth.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_001: Trouble! I found a royal document listing our rotation times!
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_002: Let's see. 'Pudding: snack after morning patrol.' They even wrote that down?
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_003: Snack time was a military secret?
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_004: It directly affects food consumption, making it a financial secret too.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_005: 'Gob: already running before being called.' Can't say that's wrong.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_006: 'Pynn: few words, but each one hurts.'
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_008: Investigator Iris is recording Watch Post blind spots alongside troop rotation times.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_009: Same time, same route, same response. Repetition is the most considerate weakness.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_010: Spying on someone else's household schedule isn't very considerate.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_011: Invaders do not wait for invitations.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_012: She's right. Annoying way of saying it, though.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_013: The investigator reads our routes; the sapper disables our facilities. Together, they open a gap for a thief to the Treasury.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_014: So we have to watch the front, facilities, and Treasury all at once.
cues.STORY_D22_MANAGEMENT_015: Then from today on, think connection, not rotation. When one moves, another supports the position.
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_001: The investigator follows the explorers, then an sapper soon breaks off toward a facility.
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_002: I made a scouting report on their side too.
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_003: Why is it titled 'Complete Domination of the Royal Intelligence Network'?
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_004: Sounds better than 'Found Two Sheets Around a Corridor Corner.'
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_005: The ink consumption suggests complete domination.
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_006: Take the investigator's bag, and she can't bring the records back, right?
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_007: Watch her hands, not just the bag. The important stuff goes in an inside pocket.
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_009: I'll help myself to the tuition from your vault.
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_011: They read us, and we read them.
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_012: It's not who reads first who wins. It's who can change after being read.
cues.STORY_D22_PRECOMBAT_013: A suitably lordly answer. Now deliver a suitably lordly execution.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_01_001: The investigator will enter shortly. Stop her before the record is complete.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_01_002: Front-line movement confirmed. High probability of delayed response at rear facilities.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_01_003: Does that calculation include me suddenly running straight at you?
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_01_004: Updated just now. To very high.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_02_002: Must be calculating the chance I'll cause trouble, not catch her.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_02_003: Gob takes the investigator. Pynn watches the sapper's route. Pudding holds the explorers.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_02_004: Another meeting right in front of me!
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_03_001: Active facility confirmed. Installing shutdown device.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_03_002: I see the installation spot. I'll destroy the device first.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_03_003: When facilities stop, income stops. For today, I am lifting Pynn's ammunition limit.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_04_002: Another late explorer follows the sapper. The thief heads for the Treasury after that.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_04_003: Don't pull everyone toward the facilities. Empty the front, and you open the thieves' route too.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_04_004: Light steps, leaning right. A junior thief. They'll hesitate twice before reaching the vault.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_05_001: Pudding, hold the line. Gob, head rearward when you've dealt with the investigator.
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_05_002: I'll really come back this time!
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_05_003: That's the second time today I'm trusting you!
cues.STORY_D22_COMBAT_05_004: Thief's route is open. I'll pin them down first.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_001: Record retrieval failed. Demon troop rotations changed during combat.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_002: You can steal our schedule, but not our minds.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_003: Then I shall have to observe longer.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_004: Can't you just leave it at a compliment?
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_005: The line held. Now we will assess actual losses to the Treasury and facilities.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_006: The Treasury and facilities are all still here.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_007: Not one coin or facility lost. A rare and beautiful sentence.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_008: We held to the end, but the rear took a little damage.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_009: I shall record the losses. Next time, I would prefer to eliminate that line altogether.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_010: Though there's a little less dust on the vault's third shelf now.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_011: When did you get in there?
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_013: The recovered watchtower records satisfy our growth requirements.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_015: From tomorrow, we may field a total of two promoted minions.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_016: A second promotion means one more of us gets stronger, right?
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_017: Good. Starting today, I'm practicing impressive expressions.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_019: Whoever is chosen, no one grows stronger alone. We're learning to support each other's gaps, just like today.
cues.STORY_D22_RESULT_WIN_020: The kingdom will test that combination too. Tomorrow, they target the throne, facilities, and Treasury.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_001: Our battle record has passed the threshold. Starting today, we may field two promoted minions in total.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_002: If I get promoted, I can cover more ground. And more snacks.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_003: The second advantage will be excluded from the review.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_004: Promote me, and I'll catch sappers before they can read the facility's name.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_005: Promote me, and I can hit enemies behind shields or fleeing into the distance immediately.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_006: All three of you are making useful points. That only makes choosing harder.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_007: I polished your chair every day too.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_008: There are no housekeeping points in the promotion review.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_010: Two out of three times, you brought the wrong item.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_013: Those two are deducting their own points.
cues.STORY_D23_MANAGEMENT_016: Today's invasion tests the throne, facilities, and Treasury in sequence. Choose by role, not by speech.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_001: We can choose a different role from our first promotion, or reinforce the same role further.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_002: Even if I'm not picked, I'll hold the front.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_003: I'll still run if I'm not picked. Just be a little louder about my disappointment.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_004: I'll shoot whatever the chosen one misses.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_005: You're all being so reasonable that it's making me nervous.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_007: Pretend not to notice. A Demon Lord has dignity to maintain.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_008: Choice confirmed. Our second promoted minion joins the battle roster today.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_010: Sharing the lead doesn't make us weaker. Let's do this together.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_011: We're right behind you. No getting all impressive on your own just because you're promoted.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_012: The celebration bonus is paid only once.
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_013: Do you have to say that during the touching moment?
cues.STORY_D23_PRECOMBAT_014: Touching moments are when overspending is most likely.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_01_001: Explorers, then shieldbearer, investigator, sapper, late explorer, and thief. Do not concentrate the new team in one place.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_01_002: First promotion holds the front. Second covers the junction. Everyone else fills the gaps between them.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_01_003: Too many guests for our very first test!
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_02_001: They brought weapons instead of presents.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_02_003: Don't all crowd the shield. Watch the investigator's route behind it.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_02_004: Two promoted individuals confirmed. Recording role distribution.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_03_003: Sapper entering shortly. Assign a separate facility defender.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_03_004: I'll go. Time to try the strength I earned today.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_04_001: Don't worry about your back. I'll hold your position too.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_04_002: A thief is following as well. The promotion bonus is inside the Treasury.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_04_004: The fastest available method of motivation.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_05_001: Sometimes that man handles thieves better than I do.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_05_002: Hold the front. Catch the thief at the junction on the way back.
cues.STORY_D23_COMBAT_05_004: No one gets past this point!
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_001: Throne, facilities, and Treasury defended. Second-promotion deployment is formally approved.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_003: Congratulations. Now we can share the hard jobs too.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_004: Save the impressive expression. Help clean up first.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_005: Two of you were promoted, but everyone won today.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_006: Two get bonuses, but everyone cleans.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_007: Nice speeches never last long here.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_008: My lord! We found a strange map in the captured investigator's bag!
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_009: Every room is marked. Corridor lengths, facilities, even the shortest route to the throne.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_011: It says, 'Don't get lost here next time.'
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_013: Selen's seal is on it too. Leon will send a formal challenge tomorrow.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_014: Finally, he's bringing a new map.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_015: This isn't funny. It means he's grown as much as we have.
cues.STORY_D23_RESULT_WIN_016: Tomorrow's advance troops will test the weaknesses marked here. Leon comes the day after, with their results.
cues.STORY_D24_MANAGEMENT_001: Leon's map is more accurate than expected. It does not cover eleven rooms, but it marks every key route in our current fortress.
cues.STORY_D24_MANAGEMENT_002: What's this circle beside the throne?
cues.STORY_D24_MANAGEMENT_005: Last time, you were pacing because you tripped over a chair leg.
cues.STORY_D24_MANAGEMENT_007: Move on to the next mark.
cues.STORY_D24_MANAGEMENT_009: Leon spent three days memorizing it and two days eating over it.
cues.STORY_D24_MANAGEMENT_010: A man can eat while studying.
cues.STORY_D24_MANAGEMENT_011: The stain in the lower left makes the Treasury route look like a lake.
cues.STORY_D24_MANAGEMENT_013: Good. Better than the days when you held your map upside down.
cues.STORY_D24_MANAGEMENT_014: It was not upside down this time. The stage for mockery has passed.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_001: The first time I came, I had to find the door. Tomorrow, I will face the routes you built head-on.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_002: You think memorizing the shortest path means you know a castle?
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_003: No. That is why today's advance party will see how you change along that path.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_004: An sapper breaks off behind the first shieldbearer. A late explorer and second shieldbearer secure the route; the investigator takes the final record.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_005: Two shields. I'll have to hold for a while.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_006: The sapper will head for a facility marked on the map. If I know the route, I can get there first.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_007: The investigator will hide behind the shields. Just give me an angle.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_008: If Leon has studied our routes, we'll study his thinking.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_009: Those are the words I was waiting for.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_010: Why do they look happy before the fighting even starts?
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_011: They've found someone just like themselves.
cues.STORY_D24_PRECOMBAT_012: They do share a hobby of making routes complicated.
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_01_001: The advance party is entering along the map's first route.
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_01_002: Let them follow the map. As far as the spot where we're waiting.
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_01_004: Shortest route, all right. I've put the quickest stop to it!
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_02_001: Sapper moving! Heading for the mark on the right!
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_02_002: Gob, pursue immediately. Pynn, watch the investigator behind the shield.
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_02_003: No angle yet. Pudding, half a step left.
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_02_004: I don't have feet! How do I take half a step?
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_03_003: The sapper is approaching a key facility.
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_04_001: Second shield unit, enter. Investigator, record the final route.
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_04_002: Actual responses differ from the existing map. Demon troops deliberately changed their front-line positions.
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_04_003: A map draws the walls, not the people standing between them.
cues.STORY_D24_COMBAT_04_004: Then tomorrow, I will read those positions as well.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_001: Advance party repelled. Every shortest-route mark on Leon's map has been invalidated.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_002: Can I mark it in red? 'Hit here.' 'Hit again over there.'
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_004: I shall bill Leon for the ink.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_005: I have received the revised records too. Tomorrow at noon, I formally challenge you again.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_006: He'll be different from the first time, won't he?
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_007: He now combines a real charge and Rallying Cry into a strategy. He is no longer a trainee who only shouts move names.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_008: We're not who we were on day one either.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_009: Right. This time, we're finding each other instead of meeting because he got lost.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_010: Leon is no longer a comical intruder. He is a rival worthy of reaching this castle's deepest point.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_011: The Demon Lord called him a rival first.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_013: I shall record it as an emotional expression.
cues.STORY_D24_RESULT_WIN_015: Already saved. Tomorrow is Leon's second challenge.
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_001: Demon Lord, let us settle this again. This time, with everything we have prepared.
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_002: Your equipment looks much the same as day one. You won't say you're lost again, will you?
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_003: I memorized the way. And I will not just shout move names loudly this time.
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_004: Bit of a shame. That was pretty funny.
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_005: Today, I actually charge after shouting.
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_007: Leon follows the vanguard. He charges through the front, then strengthens reinforcements with his Rallying Cry.
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_008: So there'll be a moment when he's out in front alone.
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_009: That is our clearest opportunity to focus our attacks.
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_010: If his charge breaks a door, may I bill Leon for repairs?
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_011: You ask that before a duel?
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_013: Don't worry. I'll keep him here today. Take your time with the invoice.
cues.STORY_D25_MANAGEMENT_014: Very well. Nor will I yield ground on my way to your throne today.
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_001: Leon is nearly here. Reinforce the line along his charge path.
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_002: Pudding takes the first charge. Gob closes in from the side. Pynn, focus him before the cry.
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_003: I'll take it. Time to show him how much tougher I've become since day one.
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_004: When Leon moves forward, his rear is open, right?
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_005: As long as you don't rush out too soon.
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_009: Watch the path, not the name!
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_010: Nnngh! He's really pushing me back this time!
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_012: Here to collect that day-one debt!
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_013: Your flanking response has improved too.
cues.STORY_D25_PRECOMBAT_015: Shields forward! Prepare the Rallying Cry!
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_01_001: Do not fear! We will open the way!
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_01_003: They really did all get faster.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_01_004: Let's shout too! Everyone... hit harder!
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_02_003: Don't get swept along by the cry. Separate Leon from his line.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_02_004: An sapper will soon head for a facility. Leon and the sapper are splitting up.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_03_001: Sapper, take the facility! I will take the throne!
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_03_002: Is that the chair you marked biggest on yesterday's map?
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_03_003: Not a chair. The place you are trying to protect.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_04_001: Should I take the sapper or stay on Leon?
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_04_002: Gob protects the facility. Pudding and Pynn take Leon. We'll hold until you return.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_04_003: Got it. This time, I'll trust you without asking again.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_04_004: And we'll trust you while we hold.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_05_001: Leon is setting up a second charge.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_05_002: An investigator follows the sapper. Do not surrender our records by focusing only on Leon.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_05_003: Pynn, pin Leon and close the investigator's route too. Watch all three threats separately to the end!
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_05_004: Do not let the line spread apart.
cues.STORY_D25_COMBAT_06_002: And we'll stop you all the way!
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_001: Still... I didn't reach the end.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_002: Day one, you got lost at the entrance. You've come a long way.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_003: I cannot tell if that is praise or mockery.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_004: Both. But today, a little more praise than mockery.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_005: Leon and all supporting troops are incapacitated. The second challenge has been stopped.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_007: Caught the sapper and came back. Really.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_008: I counted. You came back on the first try today.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_009: I shall calculate facility damage now. Leon, door repairs will be billed separately from the battle result.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_010: I lost, and I am supposed to be grateful for a discount?
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_012: Next time, I will return without the word 'trainee.'
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_013: Then I won't greet you looking like the keeper of some temporary lair either.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_014: Until then, lose to no one. I will become a full-fledged hero and reach the end of this castle.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_015: You'd better not fall along the way either. I can't have my rival's position sitting empty.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_016: I am submitting Leon's battle report to the royal council. A formal reassessment of the castle's threat level will begin.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_017: The kingdom no longer classifies this as a frivolous little lair.
cues.STORY_D25_RESULT_WIN_018: Good. From tomorrow, we'll welcome visitors worthy of the name.
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_001: A royal document has arrived. 'Registered Royal Threat No. 4: Official Demon Castle.'
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_002: An official Demon Castle at last!
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_004: Official threat status increases both invasion size and upkeep.
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_005: Why does your congratulations feel like a stab in the back?
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_006: The figures at the back are always more important.
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_007: Where do we hang the certificate?
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_008: By the entrance, where invaders can read it.
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_011: Renaming 'Temporary Demon Lair' to 'Official Demon Castle.' The first official inspection begins today.
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_012: An inspection as soon as we're registered?
cues.STORY_D26_MANAGEMENT_013: Royal administration does not provide a celebration period.
cues.STORY_D26_PRECOMBAT_001: After two advance explorers, Selen commands personally while an sapper targets facilities. Two shieldbearers and an investigator also follow.
cues.STORY_D26_PRECOMBAT_002: Now that we have a proper name, the enemies are coming properly too.
cues.STORY_D26_PRECOMBAT_004: A little. But I'm not standing at the front alone like the first time.
cues.STORY_D26_PRECOMBAT_005: I know all our routes now.
cues.STORY_D26_PRECOMBAT_006: And I can watch all our facilities.
cues.STORY_D26_PRECOMBAT_007: Right. Being official isn't just words on paper. It means they've prepared to face all of us.
cues.STORY_D26_PRECOMBAT_008: And we must overcome that preparation for our name to endure.
cues.STORY_D26_PRECOMBAT_009: Today's inspection covers more than the throne: command response, facility operation, and route control.
cues.STORY_D26_PRECOMBAT_013: The scorecards look tougher than her sword.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_01_001: Selen is entering shortly. Prepare pursuit troops.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_01_002: Shield unit, maintain the throne route. Sapper, await my signal.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_01_003: Cut Selen down first. But leave someone guarding the facilities.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_01_004: Let's time how fast we can turn that command mark off.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_02_001: I have no intention of assisting your measurements.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_02_002: I'll hold both shieldbearers. Not for long!
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_02_003: Not long. Just precisely. I've got an angle on Selen.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_03_001: The sapper is following too. Do not abandon facilities to watch Selen.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_03_002: Sapper, inspect active facilities. Shields, keep pushing.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_03_004: Do not be fooled by 'inspect.' They inspect with hammers.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_04_002: That is why I dislike them!
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_04_003: The final investigator is entering to retrieve the inspection records.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_05_001: Don't give up the records, facilities, or throne. Not one of them.
cues.STORY_D26_COMBAT_05_002: It's our first day as an official castle. Let's keep it spotless!
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_001: The inspection force has been repelled, and the throne route held to the end. Assessing facility damage now.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_002: Amending the assessment: not 'Official Demon Castle,' but 'Official Threat Undergoing Continuous Growth.'
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_006: Write all that on the door and it'll block the entrance.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_008: Right. No one can call this place temporary anymore. Or us.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_009: I never intended to leave, my lord.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_010: The long-term contract discount is already in effect.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_011: I haven't signed a contract yet.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_012: Automatically renewed based on your unauthorized vault visits.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_014: Passing the review has unlocked authorization to activate the Castle Heart.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_016: Defend it tomorrow, and we evolve into a Grand Demon Castle: eleven districts and fully developed support facilities.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_017: The royal sappers know it too. They will come to cut it off before its first beat.
cues.STORY_D26_RESULT_WIN_018: Then tomorrow, we'll let them hear that this castle is alive.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_001: Preparations to activate the Castle Heart are complete. Success will expand us to eleven districts.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_002: The castle gets a heart too?
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_003: Will we hear it beat? A great big thump would be amazing.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_004: Not if it's beside your bedroom at night.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_005: My ledger is already pounding. Very quickly whenever I look at the costs.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_006: Isn't that an alarm rather than a heartbeat?
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_007: I have no time to distinguish them.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_008: The Castle Heart connects the throne's magic with our facilities. Two sappers will try to sever different facilities.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_009: At first, I thought all I had to protect was one throne.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_010: We didn't have many rooms then.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_011: And the routes I ran were short.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_012: Less room for you to get lost too.
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_013: Are you keeping that up until the last day?
cues.STORY_D27_MANAGEMENT_014: Now, we abandon no room in this castle. We built every one of these places together.
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_001: Divide defenders among active facilities. The two sappers will not target only one place.
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_002: I'll block the route to the throne.
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_003: I pursue as soon as I see the first sapper.
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_004: I'll watch the second facility and the investigator.
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_005: Don't all gather after saving one spot. Today, the entire castle is the front line.
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_006: If possible, protect the facilities with the highest repair costs first.
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_007: The expensive ones, not the important ones?
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_008: Expensive is simply important translated into numbers.
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_010: Royal troops approaching! Two explorers, then two shieldbearers, two sappers, and two investigators!
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_012: We have two promotions. They have two sappers.
cues.STORY_D27_PRECOMBAT_013: Let's see who divides their forces better.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_01_001: The first shieldbearer is entering, followed by an sapper.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_01_002: Keep the front closed. Wait until the sapper commits to a route.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_01_003: I can wait, but the shield keeps pushing!
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_01_004: Prevent activation of the Castle Heart!
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_02_001: Don't push harder while you're talking!
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_02_002: First sapper breaking off toward an active facility!
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_02_003: Gob, pursue. Pynn, watch the second facility.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_03_003: The second shieldbearer is entering too. Do not gather your forces just because one facility is safe.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_03_004: Second sapper. Heading for another active facility.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_04_001: Pynn, pin him down. Pudding keeps the front.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_04_002: First shot hit. Installation has slowed.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_04_003: There's another shield over here, and nobody's surprised!
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_04_004: Because you're holding back even the time we'd spend being surprised!
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_05_001: That was actually a pretty good line!
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_05_002: Two investigators are entering in succession. Close the final route to the throne.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_05_003: Simultaneous disruption of both facilities failed. Switching to throne-route documentation.
cues.STORY_D27_COMBAT_05_004: Everyone to the junction! Don't give them a single step toward the Heart!
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_001: All sappers stopped. Resuming Castle Heart activation.
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_002: Magic circuits connected, support buildings expanded, eleven districts of construction costs entered...
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_009: Grand Demon Castle transition confirmed. Elite Garrison, Watch Post, recovery facilities, and Ward Core are reaching their final forms.
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_010: At first, we had one chair and a damp floor.
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_012: Eleven times the routes to run.
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_013: Eleven times the routes to get lost in.
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_014: Eleven times the places to rob.
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_015: Please do not spoil the celebration.
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_016: That sound isn't just a facility switching on. It's the sound of all of us surviving this far.
cues.STORY_D27_RESULT_WIN_017: The kingdom has begun preparing its final siege too. Tomorrow's last raid will shape the decisive battle.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_001: Two choices for the last raid: safely scout the siege route, or risk tampering with the sappers' wagons.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_002: Scouting the siege route slightly delays the whole march and sends one investigator down an empty road.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_003: Sabotage sapper supplies, and the march stays on schedule. But we can definitely remove one of the final battle's two sappers.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_004: Delay them broadly, or remove one facility threat precisely.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_005: Safe scouting costs 10 food and rewards 80 gold and 45 Infamy. Sapper disruption costs 14 food and rewards 170 gold and 90 Infamy.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_006: Bigger numbers on the risky one.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_007: Large numbers usually have a reason. Usually a bad one.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_008: Will you two be all right?
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_010: I watch the escape route if we're caught.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_012: At first, I saw a gossip and a thief. Now, you're the scouts I can trust with this castle's final move.
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_013: May I title the report 'The Demon Lord's Absolute Trust'?
cues.STORY_D28_MANAGEMENT_014: Get back alive before you exaggerate.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_001: The chosen effect applies to the final siege, not today's battle.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_002: Siege-route scouting removes one investigator and slightly delays all arrivals.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_004: Sapper supply disruption removes one sapper. Everyone else's arrival time stays the same.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_006: Choose. The kingdom's wagons won't wait for us to finish thinking.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_007: Final raid choice: Safe Siege-Route Scouting or Sapper Supply Disruption.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_008: Scout the siege route. Buy as much preparation time as possible for the last day.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_009: I'll map the empty branch. I'll make the investigator confidently wrong.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_010: Wasn't confidently wrong your reporting specialty?
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_012: Leave the supplies alone. Just change the spacing of the flags. We'll be back undetected.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_013: One investigator will be removed from the final siege, and each unit's initial arrival will be delayed.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_014: Tamper with the sappers' wagons. Remove one pair of hands reaching for our facilities on the final day.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_015: Good. Put tools and plans in different wagons, and one sapper will hunt lost property instead of fighting a war.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_016: If we're spotted, they'll send pursuers.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_017: That's why you watch the route.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_018: My role suddenly feels much more important.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_019: It always was. You just talk so much that I forgot.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_020: One sapper will be removed from the final siege. All other enemy arrival times remain unchanged.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_021: Both of you come back. That takes priority over the mission.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_022: A Demon Lord ordering a thief to return home. I'm starting to want to stay in this castle a long time.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_023: I'll deliver the report personally too. I'll exaggerate the title just a little.
cues.STORY_D28_PRECOMBAT_024: 'Just a little.' Three words. Remember them.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_01_001: Notice of a facility test before the final assessment. We will retrieve operating records for all eleven districts.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_01_003: Two explorers lead two investigators, two shieldbearers, and two sappers. Read the branches with the Watch Post and leave defenders at each facility.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_02_002: I watch the second sapper and the far-branch investigator.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_02_003: The first investigator is entering the far branch.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_02_004: Watch Post signal confirmed. Gob, not the sapper yet. Cut off the investigator first.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_03_001: Got it. Practicing emergency stops right up to the last day.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_03_003: The first sapper will shortly begin inspecting an active facility.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_03_004: That tool bag looks larger than our vault.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_04_001: It only contains the regulation equipment!
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_04_002: Let me lighten your bag before you come in.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_04_003: Pynn's idea of lighter sounds a little hot.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_04_004: The second sapper is choosing a different facility. Protect both the facility district and the throne line.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_05_001: One pursues, one guards between facilities. Don't all rush to one side.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_05_003: Finishing the first, then joining you!
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_05_004: The last investigator is almost here! Also, the raid party has returned safely!
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_06_001: Report after the fight. Right now, don't let that bag leave.
cues.STORY_D28_COMBAT_06_002: Cut off the final record. We keep the Grand Demon Castle's answer sheet!
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_001: Final reconnaissance force repelled. All eleven districts and four facility roles of the Grand Demon Castle were protected.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_002: Facility record retrieval failed. The final siege will proceed as scheduled.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_003: They failed, and they're still coming on schedule?
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_004: It's the last battle. They have nowhere left to retreat either.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_005: The chosen raid outcome is confirmed. It will apply to the final siege.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_006: And we both came back alive. Followed the Demon Lord's orders perfectly.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_008: All loot deposited in full. Very well done indeed.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_009: His emotions really do have to pass through the vault first.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_011: No royal troops will come tomorrow.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_013: No. They are leaving the last day before the siege clear to assemble the entire army.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_015: Good. Tomorrow, we don't fight. Instead, we'll make sure we all know why we're standing on that final battlefield.
cues.STORY_D28_RESULT_WIN_016: Tomorrow is the eve of the decisive battle.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_002: No morning invasion scheduled. None in the afternoon. No nighttime scouts either.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_005: Then can I sleep in today?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_006: There is a final deployment inspection.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_007: No invaders, but I have to get up even earlier?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_009: I shall add cleaning to both your schedules.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_011: Maybe the kingdom rests before the last day too.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_012: They're not resting. They're all gathering on the northern plain. More flags than trees in a forest.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_014: Normally, I'd triple the number... but today, it's a lot without exaggerating.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_015: That's the scariest thing you've said.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_016: The final siege order is confirmed: vanguard, Selen and the sappers, then the full-fledged hero Leon.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_017: Today isn't just about battle preparations. I'm taking a walk around the castle.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_019: No. I want to see the faces of everyone who came this far with me.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_020: I'll guard the throne like I did on day one.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_021: Day one, you spread wider than the throne and covered all the chair legs.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_022: I spread a little when I'm nervous.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_023: Don't cover the whole castle tomorrow.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_024: I'll be fine. I won't be standing alone tomorrow.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_027: I looked over the route Leon studied again. Tomorrow, I'll run it first.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_028: Looked at the way back too?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_030: Is that something to brag about?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_031: I used to never look at it.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_032: At first, I sent you because you were fast. Now, I send you because I know you'll come back.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_033: Say something like that out of nowhere, and I'll feel I have to run even faster tomorrow.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_034: Run faster toward coming home safely.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_035: Watch Post angles adjusted. Clear lines of fire from the recovery facility to the throne.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_036: You always prepare before you speak.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_037: Gob does all the talking for me.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_038: I can hear you talking about me!
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_039: With ears like that, he could provide listening support all the way to the rear.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_040: On day one, I never managed to ask why you were staying in our castle.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_041: I thought I stayed because I had nowhere to go.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_043: I stay because I have somewhere to come back to.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_044: Three copies of the final map are ready. One for Bati, one for my lord, and one for...
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_045: Why does the third cover say 'For Future Historians'?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_046: If we win tomorrow, it'll be a hugely important document.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_048: I'll replace 'Victorious' in the title with 'Valiant.'
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_049: Stay alive and edit it yourself.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_050: Yes. No more sending rumors and slipping away. I'll keep coming back to this castle, right to the end.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_051: Repair estimates for eleven districts, reserve food, victory bonuses, and reconstruction costs in defeat are all ready.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_052: You calculated the cost of losing too?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_053: Not calculating something is different from not wishing for it.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_055: But I placed the victory bonus ledger on top.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_056: I thought you only believed in numbers.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_057: Numbers do not lie. So I invested in the number of us who will survive tomorrow.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_059: The expenditure is not approved yet.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_060: The Treasury rating is still a secret.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_061: Found more holes to deduct points for?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_062: Plenty of holes. But now I know who comes running to each one.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_063: You came here to steal. Now you're watching our vault on the last day.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_064: Just seeing through my assessment of whether it's worth robbing.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_065: Will you steal it if it gets full marks?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_066: No. Full marks, and... I'll leave it here.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_068: I'll think about that if the door is still standing.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_069: Throne secured, Ward Core connected, emergency orders confirmed. Final preparations are nearly complete.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_070: What was the first thing you taught me?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_071: How not to run away from the throne.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_072: Was I really going to run away?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_073: You glanced toward the door about three times.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_074: Everyone here remembers far too much.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_075: Memory is how we recognize growth.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_077: Now, I will execute them rather than check them. Just give the command, my lord.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_078: Right. Tomorrow, we go together again.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_081: Within limits that do not consume our final-battle reserves.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_082: You tell us now? I'm already eating.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_083: That is why only Gob's bowl was measured.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_084: Is that why there's a line inside my bowl?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_087: Where did you get that bowl?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_088: In front of an empty chair.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_090: I shall overlook it. Today only.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_091: A miracle on the eve of battle.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_092: At first, I never imagined we'd share a meal in this castle.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_093: What did you eat back then?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_095: His lordship called it 'Demon-Realm Aged Bread.'
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_098: Surviving it was our first victory.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_099: It was. And now, every reason I have to win tomorrow is sitting around this table.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_100: What if one of us falls?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_101: The one beside them lifts them up.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_103: I'll spread out and catch them.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_105: Our lord will give the command.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_107: The order with the lowest reconstruction cost.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_108: Don't translate a touching moment into numbers.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_109: In my own way, I am being as moved as possible.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_110: I shall read a message from Roman, royal supply officer.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_111: The sappers have secured two facility approaches. Supplies will be maintained until the battle ends.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_112: He means he will supply them to the end, even in defeat. Very like him.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_114: The final siege proceeds in this order: vanguard, command and sapper corps, then Hero Leon. This is the last checklist.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_115: A checklist right to the end.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_118: Demon Lord, tomorrow there will be no trainee and no temporary lair. Hero Leon will ask your name.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_120: At first, I hid behind the title 'Demon Lord.' I didn't even know what I was really protecting.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_122: Yes. This castle, everyone living here, and the way we chose together. I can stake my name on all of it.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_124: Final Declaration: Promise a Rematch, Defend the Castle, or, if eligible, Propose a Truce.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_125: Send Leon a reply. Tell him our rivalry won't end with this battle.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_126: Recording the final declaration as Promise a Rematch.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_127: You want to win and then fight again?
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_128: If we keep growing, he'll keep coming. Next time, we'll stop him in an even finer castle.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_129: Then let's build more new routes!
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_131: I accept your promise. Then lose to no one tomorrow, or any day after.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_132: I declare that this castle and its family come before any challenger.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_133: Recording the final declaration as Defend the Castle.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_134: So tomorrow, you look to us first.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_135: You before the throne. Keeping this castle standing before chasing victory.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_136: Then we'll protect our lord first too.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_138: Understood. Then tomorrow, I will overcome everything you protect.
cues.STORY_D29_DECLARATION_ARMISTICE_001: Send the same truce offer to all three fronts. Tomorrow, let us choose an end that protects our people, not one that erases each other.
cues.STORY_D29_DECLARATION_ARMISTICE_002: Recording the Demon Castle Truce Offer, staking both the trust of all three fronts and our castle's independence.
cues.STORY_D29_DECLARATION_ARMISTICE_003: If you defend your castle, I will sheathe my sword and testify for your offer before the kingdom myself.
cues.STORY_D29_DECLARATION_ARMISTICE_004: Our sappers will keep civilian passages open. Once tomorrow's battle ends, let us review the terms together.
cues.STORY_D29_DECLARATION_ARMISTICE_005: The supply corps will prepare so neither side goes hungry. If this is an empty promise, I'll be first to put the ledger before you.
cues.STORY_D29_DECLARATION_ARMISTICE_006: Then tomorrow, we protect everyone. The day after, we eat together! I'll hold the throne even tighter.
cues.STORY_D29_DECLARATION_ARMISTICE_007: Good. Tomorrow, our castle still standing will prove the first clause of this truce.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_139: Final-battle deployment, facilities, and orders are locked in across all eleven Grand Demon Castle districts.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_140: I shall put the victory bonus ledger on top.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_141: If the door is still here tomorrow, the Treasury gets its first perfect score.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_142: I'll spread the final rumor beyond the castle myself.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_146: All preparations complete. Awaiting your command, my lord.
cues.STORY_D29_MANAGEMENT_147: We may have started by imitating others, but we raised this castle. Tomorrow, we defend it in my name and our own way.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_001: The full royal army approaches. Vanguard first, Selen and the sappers next, and Hero Leon last.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_002: The result of our final raid?
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_003: The chosen operation's effect is active as planned.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_004: Siege-route scouting succeeded! One investigator took an empty branch, and the whole siege force is a step behind.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_005: An opening we earned. Can't save it for later, so use it now.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_006: Sapper wagon disruption succeeded. Only one sapper is coming for the facilities.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_007: The rest of the siege force is on schedule. They'll come fast from the start.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_009: Selen's and the sappers' routes checked.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_010: Aim set all the way to Leon's approach.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_011: Repair funds for eleven districts are standing by. Kindly avoid using them.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_014: Vault locked too. Today, I'll guard it from the outside.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_015: The Watch Post can see royal flags stretching forever.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_016: Many enemies, but we know their order.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_017: And we know every step that brought us here. We stop them one at a time, just like day one.
cues.STORY_D30_MANAGEMENT_019: Open the gates. The true Demon Castle begins here.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_BRIEF_001: Selen and the sappers follow the vanguard. Leon enters last.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_BRIEF_002: Pudding holds the junction. Gob and Pynn move according to the enemy's target.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_BRIEF_003: I won't miss enemies breaking off toward treasure or facilities.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_BRIEF_004: When an sapper appears, I'll check which facility he's targeting first.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_BRIEF_005: I'll leave you a place to come back to!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_BRIEF_006: Good. Let's welcome them with the castle we've prepared.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_01_001: The final siege vanguard has entered. Identify their targets.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_01_002: Split and intercept according to Watch Post signals. Save strength for Selen and Leon.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_01_004: I'll watch enemies taking side routes!
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_02_002: The map said this corridor was empty!
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_03_001: The second shieldbearer follows the first.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_03_002: Come one at a time, and I'll catch you one at a time!
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_03_004: Everyone keeps saying that right in front of me today!
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_04_001: The investigator we expected took the empty branch! Nothing behind the vanguard!
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_04_002: Good. Use the opening to prepare for the next attack!
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_04_003: Got it. When our lord spots the opening, I run.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_04_004: And you'll come back this time.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_05_002: Don't spend all our firepower on the shields. An investigator is coming behind them.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_05_003: I will deliver the final route record to Leon.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_05_004: I'll make you drop that bag before delivery.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_06_001: Should I go for the investigator?
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_06_002: Circle the second shield for now. Pynn will pin down the investigator.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_06_003: Got it. When our lord spots the opening, I run.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_06_004: And you'll come back this time.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_07_002: Selen's second assault begins soon. Break the source of their enhancement before the sappers.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_07_003: Finish the vanguard. Everyone, confirm your next position!
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_07_004: Command unit entering. Remaining vanguard, advance on the mark.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_08_001: Selen's enhancement is active. Sappers and remaining vanguard are accelerating.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_08_002: Gob takes Selen. Pudding holds the remaining shields. Pynn, check which facilities the sappers approach.
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_08_003: Last command shutdown of the day!
cues.STORY_D30_COMBAT_08_004: Your approach is faster than in the previous march.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_WIN_003: No. Now I understand. Your throne was never that chair.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_WIN_004: You protected this castle and everyone in it.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_WIN_005: And I acknowledge you. You're not the trainee who first visited. You're a true hero who reached the end of my castle.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_WIN_006: Final assessment complete. No objection to official Demon Castle registration.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_WIN_007: Registration is complete. You need no one's approval anymore, my lord.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_WIN_009: We really won, all the way to the end!
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_WIN_011: I shall open the victory bonus ledger.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_WIN_013: I have the final rumor's headline: 'The True Demon Castle Begins Here.'
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_WIN_014: Hang the nameplate. Not from today, but from the first day we defended it together, this has been a true Demon Castle.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_LOSS_003: But that does not make this place a temporary lair.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_LOSS_004: Our eleven districts and all of us have not vanished. Assess the losses and give your orders again.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_LOSS_005: Next time, I won't give ground on the first charge.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_LOSS_006: I only needed to come back from the sapper one beat sooner.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_LOSS_007: Then next time, we'll make that one beat.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_LOSS_008: I shall put the reconstruction ledger underneath and open the rematch budget first.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_LOSS_009: Come again. Hero Leon will wait in the same place.
cues.STORY_D30_RESULT_LOSS_010: I fought in my own name, so this defeat is mine too. Next time, I'll stop you again at this castle's end.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_001: One week has passed since the final royal siege. Our official threat registration remains in force.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_002: In the end, the castle stood whether the kingdom acknowledged us or not.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_003: I fixed the floor by the throne. It's less damp now.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_004: Hung the new nameplate too. At the highest spot.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_007: The cost of rehanging it will be deducted from Gob's bonus.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_008: The royal map now labels this place 'Demon Castle' instead of an empty cave.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_009: At first, we borrowed a name. Now, what we did has filled it with meaning.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_010: Then the nameplate needs only this: 'The True Demon Castle Begins Here.'
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_011: Submitting a revision to the asset register. Pudding, Gob, Pynn, and Rolo are no longer classified as deployable forces.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_016: What if the food costs more?
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_018: Family doesn't do calculations like that!
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_019: Right. Family opens the fridge without calculating first.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_020: Tell the next invader: this is a home for our family, not just my minions. Very politely, before the door closes.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_021: Updating royal incursion records: minor throne damage, high security rating, minimal facility losses.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_022: My first final battle with such a spotless loss ledger. Even the upkeep is beautiful.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_023: I think you love the ledger more than the castle walls.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_024: A clean ledger means the walls are standing.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_025: I stopped a lot of them at the front.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_026: I chased every one that slipped through.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_027: I cut off the enemies targeting facilities from afar.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_028: The kingdom will record this castle as a fixed border, rather than a target of attack.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_029: No longer under 'structures that can be conquered.'
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_030: This castle does not hide. Come if you wish. I'll wall off even your road home.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_031: My lord, I barely exaggerated this rumor, but everyone else made it ten times bigger!
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_033: 'The Overlord can topple three siege towers with a single sigh.'
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_034: That sigh only toppled Goldin's stack of ledgers.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_036: Village inns lock their doors three times every night. The road here is blacked out on their maps.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_037: If they're too scared, no one will come.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_038: No enemies to chase sounds boring.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_039: No need to lock the gates, then. Fear itself will stand guard.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_040: Please adjust the rumor so food merchants can still enter. Terror must not sever our supply lines.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_041: I admit defeat. But I will not put down my sword.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_042: I declare victory. But I won't hide behind my throne.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_043: Next time, I win. Until then, lose to no one.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_044: Put a date in the contract. Be late, and I'll give your spot to another hero.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_045: Even the rival's position requires a reservation?
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_047: How did a historic pact between the kingdom and Demon Castle become a duel booking form?
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_048: Both parties are satisfied. Administratively, a success.
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_049: When Leon comes next time, can he stay for dinner?
cues.STORY_D30_ENDING_050: If he reaches the throne alive, I'll consider it. Agreed, hero. Reach my castle's end again next time.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_001: Because these are our castle's routes!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_002: Two shields. I'll stop them here!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_003: Sapper signal confirmed. Leaving the front for the facilities.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_004: Sappers, approach different active facilities. Open the way for Leon.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_005: Remaining sapper, approach an active facility. Open the way for Leon.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_006: Break a facility, and I will invoice the royal treasury!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_008: I shall send it by certified mail.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_010: It means my plan to survive is firm.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_011: Sappers entering. If our final raid disrupted their supplies, only one will approach.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_012: Whichever room he picks, I'll stop his feet first.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_013: Keep the sappers off our facilities. If Selen appears, don't lose track of the commander either.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_014: Royal troops, hold formation. Do not be shaken by the demons' orders to split up.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_015: We know better how to stand firm in a shaking castle.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_016: That is already in my records.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_017: End of records! End of command mark!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_018: Selen's command has ended. The royal enhancement is gone.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_019: The command unit's advance failed. But the final hero's path is open.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_020: Why keep opening the way for Leon to the very end?
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_021: Because only by overcoming you can that boy help the kingdom find its next answer.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_022: Then watch closely. Today, we give the answer.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_023: Leon is almost here. Move all surviving troops into position for the final duel.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_024: Hero Leon. As promised, I have reached the end of your castle.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_025: Come, Leon. My true Demon Castle begins here.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_026: That damp cave from day one has become an eleven-district citadel.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_030: Had your laugh? Now I'll stop you!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_032: A real charge. Pudding, prepare for impact at the front!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_034: Tougher than in our last duel.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_035: I'm not the only tough one. Look behind me!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_036: Aiming at the end of his charge.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_039: Good. This is a final duel!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_040: The cry is spreading! Separate the strengthened enemies from their line!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_041: Rallying Cry! Advance to the end in the kingdom's name!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_042: We don't fight in a kingdom's name. We hold on by calling each other's names!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_046: Half a step even on the last day?
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_047: We win by doing what we know.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_049: You really aren't protecting just one throne.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_051: Yes. That is why I will not yield to the very end either.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_052: I cannot fall yet. Final Oath!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_053: Some of Leon's wounds have healed. Incoming damage is also greatly reduced for a short time.
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_054: Don't waste strength on the barrier! Hold your positions, then strike again the moment the light fades!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_056: That barrier is tougher than expected. Do not needlessly add to the repair bill!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_057: Watch Leon's eyes. Don't rush in while the barrier is still up!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_058: The light is fading! I can see his movements again!
cues.STORY_D30_PRECOMBAT_062: Everyone, focus! Show him the answer of the castle we raised!
